title: Sales Manager
description:
Sobre a Empresa

A SolutionMall é uma plataforma global B2B especializada em produtos profissionais e soluções técnicas integradas. Apoiamos nossos clientes em todo o processo, incluindo identificação de necessidades, seleção de produtos, coordenação de soluções, comunicação com fornecedores, suporte a RFQs (Solicitações de Cotação), implementação de projetos e suporte à entrega.

No setor de comunicações ópticas, a SolutionMall fornece produtos e soluções para redes de telecomunicações, data centers, redes corporativas, acesso de banda larga, comunicações industriais e outras aplicações baseadas em fibra óptica.

Sobre a Vaga

Estamos procurando um(a) Gerente de Vendas – Produtos de Comunicação Óptica para apoiar o desenvolvimento de negócios e as vendas de produtos de comunicação por fibra óptica e soluções relacionadas.

A função é focada no desenvolvimento de oportunidades comerciais, compreensão dos requisitos técnicos e de compras dos clientes, suporte a RFQs e cotações, coordenação da seleção de produtos e auxílio aos clientes na identificação dos produtos de comunicação óptica mais adequados para diferentes aplicações de rede.

Esta é uma oportunidade de cooperação flexível, baseada em desempenho, com foco em clientes profissionais B2B, parceiros de canal e oportunidades de projetos.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver oportunidades de negócios com clientes, distribuidores, integradores e parceiros de canal para produtos de comunicação óptica.
  • Compreender os requisitos dos clientes relacionados a redes de fibra óptica e projetos de telecomunicações.
  • Promover cabos de fibra óptica, transceptores ópticos, patch cords, pigtails, conectores, adaptadores, ODFs (Distribuidores Ópticos), caixas de distribuição, splitters ópticos, produtos WDM e acessórios relacionados.
  • Apoiar a seleção de produtos com base em distância de transmissão, largura de banda, interface, tipo de fibra, tipo de conector e arquitetura de rede.
  • Acompanhar RFQs, cotações, necessidades de compra e oportunidades de projetos.
  • Coordenar a comunicação entre clientes, equipes da SolutionMall, fornecedores e equipes técnicas.
  • Apoiar negociações comerciais, acompanhamento de pedidos e desenvolvimento de projetos.
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos com operadoras de telecomunicações, integradores de sistemas, empreiteiros, distribuidores, clientes corporativos e parceiros de projetos.
  • Fornecer feedback de mercado sobre demanda dos clientes, tendências de produtos, preços e condições competitivas.

Qualificações

  • Experiência ou conhecimento em comunicação óptica, produtos de fibra óptica, equipamentos de telecomunicações, produtos de redes ou outros produtos técnicos B2B relacionados.
  • Bom conhecimento de produtos de comunicação por fibra óptica e suas aplicações.
  • Capacidade de compreender as necessidades dos clientes e apoiar a seleção das soluções e produtos adequados.
  • Boas habilidades em desenvolvimento de clientes, vendas e comunicação empresarial.
  • Capacidade de coordenar RFQs, cotações, fornecedores e oportunidades de projetos.
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação em inglês.

Competências Preferenciais

  • Experiência em vendas ou desenvolvimento de negócios de produtos de fibra óptica ou telecomunicações.
  • Familiaridade com cabos de fibra óptica, transceptores ópticos, componentes ópticos passivos e produtos de distribuição de fibra.
  • Experiência de trabalho com operadoras de telecomunicações, integradores de sistemas, distribuidores, empreiteiros ou clientes corporativos.
  • Experiência no suporte a RFQs, licitações, cotações ou vendas baseadas em projetos.
  • Conhecimento de aplicações como FTTx, interconexão de data centers, redes corporativas, transmissão de telecomunicações e comunicação industrial .

Remuneração e Modelo de Cooperação

Modelo de cooperação flexível, baseado no desempenho e na contribuição para os negócios.

Os termos da cooperação e a remuneração serão definidos de acordo com o desenvolvimento de clientes, oportunidades qualificadas, progresso de RFQs, desenvolvimento de projetos e resultados comerciais.

Os detalhes relevantes serão confirmados antes do início da cooperação ou da execução de qualquer projeto.

Declaração de Igualdade de Oportunidades

A SolutionMall está comprometida com a diversidade, a inclusão e a igualdade de oportunidades de cooperação.

Como se Candidatar

Candidate-se através do LinkedIn ou envie seu currículo para:

Assunto do e-mail:

Candidatura – Gerente de Vendas – Produtos de Comunicação Óptica

About the Company

SolutionMall is a global B2B platform for professional products and integrated technical solutions. We support customers through requirement discovery, product selection, solution coordination, supplier coordination, RFQ support, and project implementation and delivery support. In the optical communication sector, SolutionMall supports products and solutions for telecom networks, data centers, enterprise networks, broadband access, industrial communication, and other fiber-based communication applications.

About the Role

We are looking for a Sales Manager – Optical Communication Products to support business development and sales of fiber-optic communication products and related solutions. The role focuses on developing customer opportunities, understanding technical and purchasing requirements, supporting RFQs and quotations, coordinating product selection, and helping customers identify suitable optical communication products for different network applications. This is a flexible, performance-based cooperation opportunity focused on professional B2B customers, channel partners, and project opportunities.

Responsibilities

  • Develop customer, distributor, integrator, and channel opportunities for optical communication products
  • Understand customer requirements for fiber-optic networks and communication projects
  • Promote fiber optic cables, optical transceivers, patch cords, pigtails, connectors, adapters, ODFs, distribution boxes, splitters, WDM products, and related accessories
  • Support product selection based on transmission distance, bandwidth, interface, fiber type, connector type, and network architecture
  • Follow up on RFQs, quotations, purchasing requirements, and project opportunities
  • Coordinate communication between customers, SolutionMall teams, suppliers, and technical teams
  • Support commercial negotiations, order progress, and project development
  • Develop and maintain relationships with telecom operators, system integrators, contractors, distributors, enterprise customers, and project partners
  • Provide market feedback on customer demand, product trends, pricing, and competitive conditions

Qualifications

  • Experience or knowledge in optical communication, fiber-optic products, telecom equipment, networking products, or related B2B technical products
  • Good understanding of fiber-optic communication products and their applications
  • Ability to understand customer requirements and support suitable product selection
  • Good customer development, sales, and business communication skills
  • Ability to coordinate RFQs, quotations, suppliers, and project opportunities
  • Good English communication skills

Preferred Skills

  • Experience in sales or business development of fiber-optic or telecom products
  • Familiarity with fiber optic cables, transceivers, passive optical components, and fiber distribution products
  • Experience working with telecom operators, system integrators, distributors, contractors, or enterprise customers
  • Experience supporting RFQs, tenders, quotations, or project-based sales
  • Understanding of FTTx, data center interconnection, enterprise networks, telecom transmission, or industrial communication applications

Compensation and Cooperation Model

Flexible cooperation based on performance and business contribution. Cooperation terms and compensation will be determined based on customer development, qualified opportunities, RFQ progress, project development, and business results. Relevant details will be confirmed before cooperation or project work begins.

Equal Opportunity Statement

SolutionMall is committed to diversity, inclusion, and equal cooperation opportunities.

How to Apply

Apply through LinkedIn or send your resume to:

Email subject: Application – Sales Manager – Optical Communication Products

title: Contatólogo/ Técnico em Óptica
description:
Nós somos a EssilorLuxottica, líder global no design, fabricação e distribuição de produtos avançados para cuidados com a visão, óculos e soluções de Med-Tech. Nossa missão é Empowering Humans: empoderamos as pessoas por meio de tecnologias de lentes inovadoras, como Varilux, Stellest e Transitions; marcas icônicas como Ray-Ban, Oakley e Vogue Eyewear; as mais desejadas marcas licenciadas de luxo e bandeiras de varejo de classe mundial, como Sunglass Hut, GrandVision, Solaris e Óticas Carol.

A EssilorLuxottica está moldando um futuro no qual nossos olhos se tornam um poderoso portal de acesso capaz de elevar o potencial humano, revelar informações sobre a saúde e nos conectar com o mundo de maneiras completamente novas. Há gerações redefinimos os limites da visão, criando produtos de excelência, belos e de alto desempenho, que melhoram a visão valorizando a expressão pessoal.

Com mais de 200.000 colaboradores em 150 países, seguiremos elevando a forma como as pessoas veem o mundo, aproveitando nossos pontos fortes que vão da inovação med-tech ao diagnóstico, passando pelos wearables, IA e biometria, dando um significado mais profundo à saúde, ao bem-estar e às conexões.

Responsabilidades da posição:

  • Realizar atendimento consultivo aos clientes, identificando suas necessidades visuais e recomendando as lentes de contato mais adequadas;

  • Demonstrar as características, benefícios e diferenciais dos produtos, oferecendo recomendações personalizadas de acordo com o estilo de vida e perfil de cada cliente;
  • Efetuar provas, adaptações e acompanhamento pós-venda, assegurando a correta utilização e satisfação dos clientes;
  • Contribuir para o atingimento das metas de vendas por meio de um atendimento de excelência, fidelização e relacionamento contínuo com os clientes;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre lançamentos, tecnologias e inovações relacionadas às lentes de contato e saúde visual;
  • Apoiar a organização da loja, controle de estoque de lentes de contato e materiais relacionados, garantindo a disponibilidade dos produtos;
  • Atuar em parceria com a equipe da loja para proporcionar uma experiência de compra diferenciada e alinhada aos padrões de excelência.

Requisitos da posição:

  • Ensino técnico óptico ou graduação em óptica e optometria (obrigatório)
  • Experiência com vendas consultivas e atendimento ao cliente;
  • Conhecimento sobre lentes de contato, soluções e cuidados com a saúde ocular;
  • Disponibilidade de horário para atuação no varejo;

No Brasil, temos um programa de Diversidade, Equidade & Inclusão estruturado para ampliar oportunidades para todos. Faça parte da nossa empresa e contribua para Empowering Humans. Todas as nossas vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Sales Specialist
description:
Expand your horizons and bring the technology closer to people with BGI #OMICSFORALL

BGI Genomics was founded in 1999 with the vision of using genomics to benefit mankind and has since become the largest genomic life science organization in the world. With a focus on research and applications in the healthcare, agriculture, conservation, and environmental fields, BGI has a proven track record of innovative, high-profile research, which has generated over 2,000 publications, many in top-tier journals such as Nature and Science. BGI now operating and serving customers in more than 100 countries and areas and with around 10,000 employees all over the world.

Our mission is to transform people’s lives for the better. We don’t hesitate to take bold decisions that can help us to achieve new breakthroughs. We believe that the success of our business will mean a better world for people to live in.

Our message to the world is simple – make everyone’s life healthier and longer with help of BGI.

Why joining us?

Here at BGI we bring the most talented and dedicated to science and business professionals to act as one to deliver the outstanding technology and services to people.

Our multicultural team is engaged in a challenging work that brings satisfaction and unlimited professional growth. We keep learning and upgrading ourselves, we support each other in order to achieve the best result.

Why do we want you?

We invite to partner only the best experts who will work side by side promoting BGI’s values, products and services. And that’s why, we are confident that your business expertise and deep knowledge of genomics will help us deliver our message to the world and build strong relationship with a community.

Job Purpose & Principal Accountabilities:

1. Responsible for formulating and implementing an effective sales plan, achieving the regional sales goals within the forecasted budget, and developing a key account sales strategy.

2. Understand and master the company's current portfolio of products and services. Stay abreast of technology developments, market competition, laws, and regulations relevant to the business. Use resources and research to identify the sales plan and strategy for different market segments.

3. Carry on regional business analysis and report to regional managers regularly. Evaluate the budget performance, product performance, and operational efficiency, and report recommendations and results to the team's leader.

4. Screen for relevant business opportunities in R&D, clinical and pharmaceutical fields. Develop and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders; use clients' resources and feedback to expand the influence of BGI and safeguard key market opportunities.

5. Work in coordination with project managers, production teams, and others to guarantee the smooth implementation of the project and timely and correctly communicate the project status to the clients. Work with product managers to promote product development through collaboration with key customers.

6. Participate in national and regional conferences, trade fairs, and company meetings.

7. Understand BGI's values and expand BGI's vision in overseas markets.

Job Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:

1. In-depth knowledge of NGS and IVD markets and customer needs in this industry.

2. In-depth knowledge of selling next-generation sequencing and other genomic services such as microarray, genotyping, in vitro diagnosis, etc.

3. Experience with government relations and lobbying for the pharmaceutical and biotech industry.

4. Excellent communication, analytical and organizational skills.

5. Willingness to travel.

6. Fluency in English, (Chinese preferred )

7.Base Sao Paulo.

Competences:

a. At least two years of experience in customer management in the biotechnology or Healthcare industry.

b. A Bachelor's Degree or above in biology, biochemistry, molecular biology, bioinformatics or equivalent.

Here at BGI we value people and consider our employees as partners. Transparent, fair and friendly environment is what we created here. Agile approach in management is what we implement here and we give each partner enough independence as well as guidance. We take care of our partners’ physical and mental health and we are dedicated to the life-work balance corporate culture.

Not only do we bring genomics closer to people, we also participate in various charity programs, advocate nature preservation, and support equality. We condemn any discrimination and committed to giving job opportunity to everyone regardless of sex, race, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status etc.

· What do we offer?

1. International, cross-cultural, and cross-functional team

2. work with advanced technology and products

3. comprehensive onboarding program

4. continuous knowledge and skills development

5. HQ organized training globally and in China

6. official permanent work agreement and all social benefits

7. annual performance bonus

8. team building activities

9. salary range BRL 7.500 - 11.500 gross monthly.

Let’s move to the brighter and more equal future together and deliver #Omicsforall

title: Analista de Instrumentação e Equipamentos de Testes
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Instrumentação e Equipamentos de Teste para atuar na gestão, calibração, manutenção e evolução tecnológica dos equipamentos de teste e de toda a cadeia de medição, incluindo sensores, cabos, conectores e sistemas de aquisição de dados.

Esse(a) profissional será uma referência técnica para engenheiros e técnicos, apoiando a seleção, configuração e utilização correta de instrumentação em bancadas e veículos. Também será responsável por assegurar a confiabilidade das medições, a disponibilidade dos equipamentos e a melhoria contínua do parque de testes.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida dos equipamentos de teste e instrumentação, incluindo inventário, criticidade, padrões, documentação e rastreabilidade.
  • Planejar e acompanhar a agenda de calibração e manutenção preventiva e corretiva dos equipamentos.
  • Garantir a conformidade metrológica e a máxima disponibilidade dos sistemas de teste.
  • Diagnosticar falhas e realizar troubleshooting em sistemas de aquisição de dados, sensores, cabos, conectores e módulos de condicionamento de sinal.
  • Identificar e solucionar problemas relacionados a ruído, aterramento, interferência e integridade de sinal.
  • Configurar e comissionar sistemas de aquisição de dados e instrumentação de acordo com as necessidades dos testes.
  • Apoiar a montagem e a validação de setups de instrumentação em bancadas e veículos.
  • Definir, documentar e manter procedimentos, instruções de trabalho e padrões técnicos de instrumentação.
  • Estabelecer boas práticas de medição, montagem, inspeção, manuseio e armazenamento de sensores e equipamentos.
  • Treinar e suportar engenheiros e técnicos no uso correto e eficiente dos sistemas de medição.
  • Realizar análises de obsolescência e mapear necessidades futuras de equipamentos e tecnologias.
  • Elaborar roadmaps para atualização e expansão de data loggers, sensores e acessórios.
  • Apoiar solicitações de investimento e a seleção técnica de novos equipamentos.
  • Atuar como interface técnica com fornecedores e sites globais para alinhamento de tecnologias, métodos e requisitos locais.

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Elétrica, Eletrônica ou área correlata.
  • Experiência profissional entre 4 e 10 anos em equipamentos de teste, instrumentação, sistemas de medição, laboratórios de engenharia ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência prática com sensores de temperatura, pressão, aceleração e/ou strain gages.
  • Vivência com acessórios de instrumentação, cabeamento, conectores e condicionamento de sinais.
  • Conhecimento sólido dos fundamentos de metrologia e das rotinas de calibração.
  • Conhecimento sobre rastreabilidade metrológica, certificados, tolerâncias e gestão de intervalos de calibração.
  • Experiência com sistemas de aquisição de dados, incluindo configuração, instalação, comissionamento e troubleshooting.
  • Conhecimento sobre ruído, aterramento, blindagem e integridade de sinal.
  • Capacidade de organizar inventários, agendas, documentação e planos de manutenção.
  • Inglês avançado para leitura, escrita, conversação e interação com equipes globais e fornecedores.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação em Curitiba, Paraná .

DIFERENCIAIS

  • Experiência com sistemas de aquisição de dados Dewesoft .
  • Experiência com equipamentos e soluções IPETRONIK .
  • Vivência com soluções HBM, National Instruments, Vector, ETAS ou plataformas similares.
  • Familiaridade com barramentos e protocolos veiculares, como CAN, LIN e Ethernet.
  • Experiência em laboratórios de validação, testes automotivos, testes de durabilidade, NVH ou engenharia experimental.
  • Conhecimento de instrumentação e aquisição de dados em veículos.
  • Experiência com análise de obsolescência e elaboração de roadmaps tecnológicos.
  • Vivência na interface técnica com fornecedores e equipes internacionais.

CONTRATAÇÃO E BENEFÍCIOS

  • Refeição no local
  • Plano de saúde Unimed
  • Seguro de vida
  • Vale-transporte
  • Wellhub
  • Horário: de segunda a sexta-feira, das 8h às 17h15
  • Modelo de trabalho: 100% presencial
  • Local: Curitiba, Paraná

title: Customer Service Specialist (USA Humanitarian / Asylum Immigration Services)
description:

Bueno Law is a mission driven law firm dedicated to helping survivors of domestic violence, human trafficking, and members of the LGBTQ+ community find safety and freedom in the United States through legal status. We specialize in humanitarian visas, asylum, and deportation defense.

We’re a purpose‑driven, fast‑growing team that embraces challenges, values growth, and steps boldly outside comfort zones.

We’re looking for a Customer Service Specialist who can confidently assist clients, support attorneys, and maintain exceptional professionalism in a fast‑paced, emotionally complex environment. Many of our clients are navigating trauma, uncertainty, or heightened stress. Your ability to stay grounded, empathetic, and composed will directly shape their experience with our firm.

Fluency in English—both spoken and written—is required for this role as is the ability to work 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM US Pacific time.

Detail Orientation

Soft Skills

title: Regional Manager, Tender Management and Pricing
description:
The Regional Manager, Tender Management and Pricing is responsible for leading both the pricing strategy and the tender management lifecycle across a defined geographic region. They oversee all aspects of pricing and bid management to drive competitive, margin‑conscious decisions across multimodal product lines. They partner closely with Sales, Operations, Procurement, and Carrier Management to develop aligned bid strategies and deliver winning tender responses. They build strong relationships with carriers, evaluate market conditions, and lead cross‑functional teams through complex RFQs, RFPs, and tender cycles. They develop regional pricing frameworks, establish best practices, and drive continuous improvement in pricing accuracy, tender quality, and commercial outcomes. They also provide strategic insights based on post‑tender evaluations, helping refine future pursuits and improve long‑term profitability.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee and manage the complete pricing and tender lifecycle, including analysis of wins/losses, pipeline performance, and regional pricing positions.
  • Develop and execute clear bid strategies in collaboration with sales, technical teams, and cross‑functional stakeholders, defining win themes, timelines, and resource needs.
  • Lead and motivate cross‑functional bid teams, assigning responsibilities, tracking deliverables, and ensuring timely, high‑quality tender submissions.
  • Conduct comprehensive reviews of RFPs, RFQs, and customer requirements to identify risks, operational considerations, and solution opportunities.
  • Manage regional relationships with air, ocean, and ground carriers, securing competitive rates and optimizing procurement strategies.
  • Develop regional pricing frameworks across multimodal services (ground, intermodal, air, ocean, contract logistics, etc.).
  • Ensure pricing outputs support profitable growth, align with target margins, and reinforce customer value propositions.
  • Partner with Operations to understand cost drivers, service capabilities, network constraints, and profitability levers.
  • Drive pricing strategy in alignment with Regional Sales leadership, ensuring consistency and commercial competitiveness.
  • Maintain visibility of regional pricing and tender pipeline performance, including turnaround time, quality metrics, and commercial outcomes.
  • Conduct post‑tender and post‑award reviews to identify lessons learned and implement continuous improvement best practices.
  • Stay informed on industry trends, competitor activity, market shifts, and procurement practices to guide strategic pricing decisions.
  • Provide training, coaching, and best‑practice guidance to regional sales and support teams on pricing tools and tender processes.
  • Support digital pricing initiatives, workflow standardization, and process optimization across regional teams.
  • All other duties as assigned to meet evolving business needs.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Supply Chain, Administration, Foreign Trade, Project Management) from an accredited college or university required.
  • Certification/Licensure: Industry certifications such as CILT, CSCMP, APICS, FIATA, etc. preferred but not required.
  • Languages: English (Advanced) and Native Spanish (Advanced).
  • 3+ years of experience in pricing, tender management, and/or air/ocean freight forwarding.
  • Strong understanding of procurement processes, tender documentation, bid structures, and commercial/legal frameworks.
  • Excellent organizational, planning, and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and concisely.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving capabilities.
  • Demonstrated discretion and confidentiality in handling and protecting sensitive information.
  • Technical: Proficient with common office technologies, including Windows PCs, Microsoft O365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) and web conferencing (Teams, Zoom, Webex, etc.).
  • Environment: Comfort commuting to/from and working in a 100% on‑site setting (listed in this posting), with travel for related meetings/events.

title: Head of Learning & Culture
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a Head of Culture & Learning to join our People & Organization team. In this role, you'll be a key driver of how we grow our people and shape the way we work together — building learning ecosystems and culture programs that scale with a fast-moving organization. This is a high-impact, hands-on role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, moves fast, and knows how to turn ideas into programs that actually stick.

What You'll Do

  • Champion and evolve our organizational culture, ensuring it remains a competitive advantage as the company grows
  • Design and lead initiatives that reinforce our values in day-to-day work — from onboarding to team rituals and beyond
  • Partner with leadership and cross-functional teams to embed cultural practices across all levels of the organization
  • Measure culture health and continuously iterate based on feedback and data
  • Build and manage end-to-end learning journeys for key talent segments (new hires, individual contributors, managers, leaders)
  • Identify capability gaps and design scalable programs — whether in-person, digital, or blended
  • Act as a strategic thought partner to HR Business Partners and senior leaders on people development topics
  • Manage budgets, timelines, and vendors with a results-oriented mindset
  • Build buy-in for culture and learning initiatives across a diverse, often distributed workforce

What We're Looking for

  • 10+ years of experience in L&D, organizational culture, or talent development
  • Proven track record in fast-paced, high-growth environments — internet, tech, or similarly dynamic industries strongly preferred
  • Experience designing and scaling learning programs from scratch, not just inheriting and maintaining
  • Strong facilitation and communication skills — you're as comfortable in a workshop as in a C-suite conversation
  • Data-driven mindset: you measure what matters and use it to improve
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and operate independently with minimal structure
  • Experience working across cultures or in multinational environments is a plus
  • Fluency in English required; additional languages

What Makes You Stand Out

  • You've built something from 0 to 1 — a program, a culture initiative, an L&D function
  • You understand that culture isn't a campaign — it's behavior, reinforce
  • You're energized by change, not slowed down by it.

title: Integration Architect
description:
Transforming the Future of Enterprise Planning

At o9, our mission is to be the Most Value-Creating Platform for enterprises by transforming decision-making through our AI-first approach. By integrating siloed planning capabilities and capturing millions—even billions—in value leakage, we help businesses plan smarter and faster.

This not only enhances operational efficiency but also reduces waste, leading to better outcomes for both businesses and the planet. Global leaders like Google, PepsiCo, Walmart, T-Mobile, AB InBev, and Starbucks trust o9 to optimize their supply chains.

Integration Architect

At o9, we invest in people. We seek talented, driven individuals to power our transformative approach. You’ll thrive in a dynamic, supportive environment, growing while making a real impact.

What you’ll do for us

  • Design, build and deploy effective SSIS packages to validate, synthesize, transform customer data for integrated business planning and analytics.
  • Understand o9 platform’s data model (table structures, linkages, optimal designs) for designing various planning use cases.
  • Review and analyze the data provided by customers along with its technical/functional intent and interdependencies.
  • Lead customer sessions in the technical design, data requirements gathering and making recommendations on best practices, in case of inaccurate or missing data.
  • Design and automate the data loading and insights generation process with intelligent checks and balances for sustained value delivery.
  • Design and support execution of test plans, document issues and track progress at resolving issues.

What you’ll have

Experience:

  • 8+ Years. Experience with planning applications.
  • Experience in building scalable ML frameworks by identifying and collecting relevant input data, feature engineering, tuning, and testing.
  • ETL development with at least 1 year in designing ETL solutions for clients is a MUST.
  • (SSIS is preferred)
  • Experience in Creating/Testing Web API via Postman /C#/ JavaScript.
  • Good to have experience working with Hive/Hadoop/Python.
  • Knowledge and experience in Apache NiFi / Apache Airflow.
  • Prior work experience on Supply chain.
  • Strong experience in Cloud Data Quality, Source Systems Analysis, Business Rules Validation, Source Target Mapping Design, Performance Tuning and High-Volume Data Loads.
  • Education: BE/Btech/Mtech/MCA.

Skills:

  • Languages: SQL , MDX, T-SQL with knowledge of DDL, DML, stored procedures, triggers and performance tuning is a must. Leveraging ETL tools like SSIS for data transformations. Python, Bash, and/or Powershell Scripting; Amazon Web Services (AWS), AZURE, Google Cloud Infrastructures preferred.
  • Some Knowledge of C# /JavaScript / VB.NET or analytical packages like R is desirable.
  • Proficient in the use of Microsoft Excel/PowerPoint /Visio for analysis and presentation
  • Knowledge on handling JSON files, Serializing the data, Posting data to API is desirable.
  • Strong Technical and communications skills.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary – We recognize and reward talent.
  • Tech Tools – Choose a Windows or PC laptop, whatever helps you work best.
  • Flexible Work – Work from home two days a week—less commuting, more time for what matters.
  • Supportive Team – Work alongside a diverse, talented team you can learn from every day.
  • Diversity & Inclusion – We celebrate our international workforce and value different perspectives.
  • Food & Drink – Enjoy healthy snacks, fresh fruit, teas, and coffees.

How the process works

  • Apply – Submit your application by clicking the below.
  • Initial Contact – Our recruiter will connect with you via video or phone call to discuss the role and understand your background.
  • Online Assessment - (If Applicable)
  • Tech Round 1 – An initial technical discussion to evaluate your skills and expertise.
  • Tech Round 2 – A deeper technical assessment to understand your approach and proficiency.
  • Managerial Round – A conversation with the hiring manager to evaluate collaboration, team fit, and growth potential.
  • HR Round – A final discussion on company culture, expectations, and career progression.

More about us…

At o9, transparency and open communication are at the core of our culture. Collaboration thrives across all levels—hierarchy, distance, or function never limit innovation or teamwork. Beyond work, we encourage volunteering opportunities, social impact initiatives, and diverse cultural celebrations.

With a $3.7 billion valuation and a global presence across Dallas, Amsterdam, Barcelona, Madrid, London, Paris, Tokyo, Seoul, and Munich, o9 is among the fastest-growing technology companies in the world. Through our aim10x vision, we are committed to AI-powered management, driving 10x improvements in enterprise decision-making. Our Enterprise Knowledge Graph enables businesses to anticipate risks, adapt to market shifts, and gain real-time visibility. By automating millions of decisions and reducing manual interventions by up to 90%, we empower enterprises to drive profitable growth, reduce inefficiencies, and create lasting value.

o9 is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, ensuring a fair and unbiased hiring process. Join us as we continue our growth journey!

title: Art Center & Events Administrative Support Intern
description:
Primary Purpose of the Position

The Art Center & Events Administrative Support Intern provides administrative, scheduling, and operational support to the Events Coordinator & Development Associate Manager in the coordination and execution of events across Graded.

A primary responsibility is to support reservations and scheduling for Art Center spaces, including the Black Box Theatre, Haddad Center, Art Gallery, classrooms, and other designated areas. The Art Center & Events Administrative Support Intern also assists with event records, calendar updates, service requests, purchase orders, payment processes, event preparation, and on-site logistical support.

Principle Duties and Responsibilities

Art Center Reservations & Scheduling

  • Support reservations and scheduling for Art Center spaces.
  • Review requests, check availability, identify scheduling conflicts, and maintain accurate reservation records.
  • Enter and update approved reservations in EvM and relevant school calendars.
  • Communicate confirmations, changes, and space-use information to requesters.
  • Follow up on missing information and escalate conflicts or exceptions to the Events Coordinator & Development Associate Manager.

Event Management System & Calendar Support

  • Provide administrative and logistical support for school events.
  • Assist with event schedules, checklists, service requests, guest information, signage, and other operational materials.
  • Coordinate routine requests with Maintenance, ICT, Cafeteria, Security, and other departments as needed.
  • Maintain organized event records, files, spreadsheets, and supporting documentation.
  • Assist with the creation of purchase orders in the ERP system, payment requests, and process follow-up.
  • Support faculty and staff with routine questions related to reservations and event procedures.

Event Coordination & Administrative Support

  • Assist with event setup and breakdown and help ensure spaces are ready for scheduled use.
  • Support guest reception, registration, wayfinding, and other event-day activities as needed.
  • Monitor assigned event spaces and report operational, maintenance, safety, or facility concerns.
  • Help ensure spaces are properly reset following events.
  • Support evening and weekend events when required and permitted within the internship schedule.
  • Assist with the creation of purchase orders in the ERP system, as well as with payment requests and follow-up throughout the process.

Art Center Space Readiness

  • Conduct routine checks of Art Center spaces in connection with scheduled reservations and events.
  • Help ensure that reserved spaces are organized and ready for use.
  • Identify and report concerns related to cleanliness, furniture, audiovisual equipment, maintenance, safety, or general facility conditions.
  • Support the organization of event supplies, signage, materials, and other shared resources.
  • Report discrepancies between approved reservations and actual space usage to the Events Coordinator & Development Associate Manager.
  • Assist in maintaining organized records related to Art Center space utilization and recurring operational needs.

Professional Practice

  • Work under the direction of the Events Coordinator & Development Associate Manager and collaborate professionally with different school departments.
  • Maintain confidentiality and appropriate professional boundaries with students.
  • Comply with Graded’s Child Safeguarding Code of Conduct, policies, and procedures.
  • Demonstrate professionalism, reliability, organization, and a service-oriented approach.
  • Perform other internship-related duties as assigned by the Events Coordinator & Development Associate Manager.

Certifications and Education

Currently enrolled in an undergraduate degree program eligible for a formal internship.

Experience

  • Previous internship, volunteer, university, or extracurricular experience involving events, administration, customer service, scheduling, or project support.
  • Familiarity with calendars, spreadsheets, reservation systems, or event management tools.

title: Human Resources Director
description:
Pacific International Recruitment is a specialist executive search consultancy with over 25 years of experience placing senior and niche talent. Headquartered in London, with additional offices in Düsseldorf and Philadelphia, we support clients and candidates across EMEA and the USA with tailored recruitment solutions.

We are seeking an experienced Regional HR Director to join within a fast-paced industrial business. This is a high-impact role responsible for driving people strategy, organisational effectiveness, and operational excellence across multiple international markets.

This position is responsible for overseeing one manufacturing plant in São Paulo (SP) and commercial offices across Latin America.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with leadership to align people strategy with business goals, driving organisational performance and workforce planning.
  • Lead initiatives across talent acquisition, succession planning, leadership development, and capability building to strengthen organisational growth.
  • Foster an inclusive, high-performance culture while leading change management initiatives that support transformation and employee engagement.
  • Manage employee and industrial relations matters, ensuring compliance with employment legislation, policies, and workplace standards.
  • Oversee efficient HR operations, systems, and processes, continuously improving service delivery and operational effectiveness.

Ideal Candidate:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree in Human Resources or a related field preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive HR leadership experience within complex, fast-paced organisations.
  • Demonstrated success leading multifunctional and multicultural teams across diverse business environments.
  • Experience within multi-site industrial or manufacturing environments and decentralised organisations.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and partner effectively with senior leadership.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (mandatory).
  • Energetic, adaptable, and change-oriented mindset with strong communication and interpersonal skills.

For further information on this position and a confidential discussion about your career please contact Dominic Reed, Executive Search Associate - though we ask you to apply directly through this LinkedIn post to make sure your application is reviewed.

About Pacific International Executive Search:

Pacific International, a globally recognized retained executive search firm, is dedicated to empowering Fortune 500, FTSE 100, and high-growth enterprises in building exceptional C-suite, senior-level, and strategic leadership teams while championing diversity and inclusion. Our adaptability, agility, and forward-thinking ethos distinguish us in the ever-evolving business landscape.

Since 1997, we have been dedicated to building lasting client partnerships based on trust and reliability, and a proven track record of successful C-suite and mid- to senior-level leadership project delivery across many key industries globally.

Diversity Statement:

At Pacific International, diversity, equity, and inclusion are at the core of who we are and what we do. Our commitment to these values is unwavering and we proudly champion diversity on behalf of our clients in every Executive Search mandate we undertake. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law. In pursuit of these objectives, we actively encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and identities.

title: Analista de Investimentos Sênior (foco backoffice)
description:
A IRB(Asset) foi criada em 2018 como braço de investimentos do IRB(Re), maior ressegurador do Brasil. Com mais de 85 anos de experiência no mercado, o IRB(Re) atua em nove linhas de negócios, em diversos países e em mais de 50 moedas. A companhia gera reservas superiores a R$ 8 bilhões, sendo 60% no mercado doméstico e 40% no mercado externo.

Com profundo conhecimento do setor, o IRB(Asset) faz a gestão de produtos a partir das reservas técnicas do grupo ressegurador e ativos livres. Nosso objetivo é gerar rentabilidade consistente e de longo prazo com uma abordagem prudente e responsável.

Conheça os detalhes da vaga abaixo:

FORMAÇÃO ACADÊMICA:

  • Necessário superior completo em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Ciências Contábeis, Matemática, Estatísticas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Diferencial: pós-graduação/MBA em exatas;
  • Diferencial: certificações do mercado financeiro (CPA-20, CEA, CGA, CFG, CFA ou equivalentes).

EXPERIÊNCIA/CONHECIMENTOS:

  • Experiência prévia em Backoffice, Middle Office, Operações, Administração Fiduciária ou Custódia de fundos de investimento;
  • Necessário conhecimento de produtos financeiros de renda fixa, fundos de investimento, derivativos e mercado de capitais;
  • Vivência com processos de liquidação, conciliação, controle de posições e rotinas operacionais de fundos;
  • Conhecimento da regulamentação aplicável ao mercado de capitais e fundos de investimento;
  • Excel avançado;
  • Conhecimento em Power BI, SQL ou ferramentas de automação será considerado diferencial;
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de mercado financeiro e plataformas de administração de fundos.

IDIOMA:

  • Necessário Inglês intermediário.

MISSÃO DA POSIÇÃO:

Atuar nas atividades de backoffice da Asset, assegurando a correta execução, controle, conciliação e monitoramento das operações dos fundos e carteiras administradas, garantindo conformidade regulatória, integridade das informações, eficiência operacional e suporte à tomada de decisão. O profissional terá papel fundamental na interface entre as áreas de Gestão, Compliance, Riscos, Administradores, Custodiantes e demais áreas corporativas do grupo.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

Operações e Controle

  • Executar e acompanhar o processamento das operações (onshore e offshore) realizadas pelos gestores, assegurando o correto registro junto aos administradores, custodiante e demais prestadores de serviço.
  • Realizar conciliações diárias de posições, movimentações financeiras, ativos e cotas dos fundos.
  • Monitorar eventos corporativos, incluindo amortizações, pagamentos de juros, dividendos, resgates, vencimentos e demais ocorrências relacionadas aos ativos sob gestão.
  • Garantir a liquidação financeira das operações e acompanhar pendências operacionais junto às contrapartes.

Controle de Fundos e Carteiras

  • Acompanhar a apuração de cotas dos fundos de investimento e validar informações fornecidas pelos administradores fiduciários.
  • Monitorar enquadramento regulatório, limites operacionais e restrições de investimento estabelecidas pela regulamentação, políticas internas e diretrizes do grupo.
  • Apoiar processos de abertura, alteração e encerramento de fundos e veículos de investimento.
  • Elaborar controles e indicadores relacionados às atividades operacionais da Asset.

Governança e Compliance

  • Apoiar o atendimento às exigências regulatórias dos órgãos supervisores e autorreguladores.
  • Participar da preparação de informações e documentos para auditorias internas, externas e fiscalizações.
  • Contribuir para o aperfeiçoamento dos controles internos, políticas e procedimentos operacionais.
  • Zelar pela aderência às normas de compliance, prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro e demais normativos internos e externos.

Relacionamento com Prestadores e Áreas Internas

  • Ser ponto focal para administradores fiduciários, custodiante, distribuidores, corretoras e demais prestadores de serviços.
  • Atuar em conjunto com as áreas de Gestão, Riscos, Compliance, Jurídico, Contabilidade e Tesouraria para resolução de demandas operacionais.
  • Apoiar a elaboração de reportes gerenciais e regulatórios para a Asset e para o grupo econômico.

BENEFÍCIOS:

  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Auxílio creche
  • Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados
  • Previdência privada
  • Seguro de vida
  • Vale alimentação
  • Vale-refeição
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass)

title: Data Specialist (with Advanced English)
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

About the Role:

We’re currently working on expanding our Central Data Team to increase our product portfolio with members who build, create and maintain our data products. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply.

The Data Specialist plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Specialist works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.

to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current Data Specialists love working here!

As Our Data Specialist, you will:

  • Take ownership of high-impact work with guidance — whether that’s running or building data products end-to-end, supporting centralized data ingestion pipelines the broader team relies on, or building clean, granular data feeds that help clients dive into data.
  • Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies we cover and datasets we analyze. You’ll learn our proprietary methods and techniques, building the judgment and mental models to understand why our data works — not just how to produce it.
  • Use AI and tooling to accelerate your learning and work — assisting with queries, investigations, debugging, and repetitive tasks. You’ll develop the habit of validating AI-generated outputs rather than assuming correctness, building a foundation for using AI effectively throughout your career here.
  • Become a trusted resource for internal stakeholders and clients , working with them to identify and answer key questions. You’ll contribute to data feeds, custom analyses, and reports consumed by the top investors in the world.
  • Improve the products, pipelines, and data feeds you own — we value curiosity and experimentation, and we expect you to follow established best practices while also questioning the status quo and identifying opportunities for improvement.
  • Learn or sharpen SQL, Python, and PySpark skills starting with our two-month new hire training program covering technical fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have a strong ownership mentality — you want to ensure our products are the best in the world and take personal responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks
  • You have strong attention to detail and produce work with minimal errors
  • You communicate clearly, both orally and in writing — including proactively sharing progress, blockers, and updates
  • You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible and are excited about using AI and tooling to work smarter
  • You can manage multiple priorities and stay organized
  • You are experimental and curious — energized by learning and not afraid to change the status quo
  • You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company

What We Offer:

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:

  • We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer vacation time, team events and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Supervisor(a) de Frota
description:
Modelo de contratação: PJ

Remuneração: Fixo (60% a 70%) + Variáveis (40% a 30%) *conforme metas

Missão da posição

Responsável pela gestão integral da frota própria e locada da companhia, garantindo disponibilidade, produtividade, segurança e controle de custos dos veículos , desde sua entrada na operação até manutenção, abastecimento, pedágios, multas, documentação e eventual desmobilização.

Principais responsabilidades

Gestão e disponibilidade da frota

  • Controlar diariamente frota total, disponível, alocada, parada, em manutenção e ociosa;
  • Garantir disponibilidade dos veículos conforme demanda operacional;
  • Acompanhar alocação e utilização dos veículos entre operações e bases;
  • Identificar veículos subutilizados e atuar na redução da ociosidade;
  • Controlar entrada, transferência, substituição e desmobilização de veículos;
  • Manter inventário e cadastro da frota atualizados.

Manutenção

  • Gerenciar manutenção preventiva e corretiva;
  • Criar e garantir cumprimento do plano de manutenção preventiva por veículo;
  • Controlar quilometragem e gatilhos de revisão;
  • Acompanhar veículos parados em oficinas e cobrar prazos dos fornecedores;
  • Aprovar e auditar orçamentos de manutenção;
  • Analisar reincidência de defeitos e custo por veículo;
  • Desenvolver e negociar fornecedores, oficinas e prestadores;
  • Atuar diretamente na redução do tempo médio de manutenção e indisponibilidade.

Custos e eficiência

  • Acompanhar custo total da frota e custo individual por veículo;
  • Construir e acompanhar orçamento mensal da área;
  • Controlar custos com manutenção, pneus, locação, combustível, pedágio, multas e demais despesas;
  • Identificar desvios e apresentar planos de redução de custos;
  • Avaliar economicamente manutenção x substituição/desmobilização de veículos;
  • Trabalhar com visão de TCO – Total Cost of Ownership .

Combustível

  • Controlar consumo e despesas de abastecimento;
  • Monitorar km/l por veículo, motorista, operação e categoria;
  • Identificar consumo fora do padrão;
  • Investigar abastecimentos incompatíveis, duplicidades e possíveis desvios;
  • Administrar fornecedores, cartões e sistemas de abastecimento.

Pedágios

  • Controlar utilização e custos de tags;
  • Conciliar veículos, placas e cobranças;
  • Identificar cobranças indevidas ou incompatíveis com as rotas realizadas;
  • Controlar ativação, bloqueio e substituição de tags.

Multas e documentação

  • Controlar multas, notificações, indicação de condutores e respectivos prazos;
  • Garantir correta responsabilização e tratativa financeira das infrações;
  • Controlar licenciamento, IPVA, seguros e demais documentos obrigatórios;
  • Garantir que nenhum veículo opere com documentação irregular.

Gestão de terceiros e locadoras

  • Gerenciar relacionamento com locadoras;
  • Controlar contratos, franquias de quilometragem, avarias e cobranças adicionais;
  • Auditar faturas e divergências;
  • Controlar veículos substitutos e SLA de atendimento;
  • Negociar condições comerciais e operacionais quando necessário.

Gestão de equipe

  • Liderar e desenvolver o time de Frota;
  • Distribuir responsabilidades e acompanhar produtividade;
  • Criar rotinas de gestão e acompanhamento diário;
  • Estabelecer processos, SLAs e responsabilidades claras;
  • Desenvolver uma cultura de controle, agilidade e senso de dono.

Experiência desejada

  • Experiência anterior em gestão de frota de transportadoras, operadores logísticos, locadoras ou empresas com frota relevante;
  • Experiência com veículos comerciais leves, VUCs, vans e/ou caminhões;
  • Conhecimento de manutenção preventiva e corretiva;
  • Experiência com gestão de oficinas e fornecedores;
  • Conhecimento de combustível, pedágio, multas e documentação;
  • Experiência com gestão de equipe;
  • Excel intermediário/avançado;
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de gestão de frota e telemetria;
  • Forte capacidade de leitura e análise de indicadores.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em transportadora ou operação Last Mile/B2B;
  • Gestão simultânea de frota própria e locada;
  • Conhecimento de TCO;
  • Experiência com implantação de processos e indicadores;
  • Ferramentas de análise de dados; 
  • Conhecimento de telemetria e gestão de comportamento de condução.

title: Coordenador(a) de FP&A - Planejamento de Compras | Varejo

Há mais de 36 anos, a Di Gaspi é referência no varejo de moda, oferecendo produtos de qualidade, preço justo e excelência no atendimento ao cliente.   • Elaborar e acompanhar Budget e Forecast;
  • Acompanhar e analisar o DRE gerencial, identificando oportunidades e desvios;

  • Desenvolver cenários e projeções para suporte à tomada de decisão;
  • Acompanhar o desempenho financeiro e comercial das categorias;
  • Analisar o impacto das decisões de compras sobre custos, margem e rentabilidade;
  • Avaliar impactos tributários relacionados às compras e à formação de custos no varejo;
  • Elaborar relatórios, indicadores e dashboards gerenciais;
  • Atuar em parceria com as áreas de Compras e Comercial no planejamento de abastecimento e investimentos;

  • Apresentar análises e recomendações para a liderança.

Requisitos

  • Experiência em FP&A, planejamento financeiro e/ou planejamento de compras;
  • Experiência no segmento de varejo;
  • Conhecimento avançado em OTB – Open to Buy;
  • Conhecimento de Budget, Forecast e DRE gerencial;
  • Domínio de indicadores de margem, estoque, giro, cobertura e capital de giro;
  • Conhecimento de Excel avançado;
  • Experiência com BI e construção de dashboards gerenciais;
  • Capacidade analítica para elaboração de cenários e projeções;
  • Conhecimento sobre tributação e formação de custos no varejo.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência no varejo de moda, calçados ou artigos esportivos;
  • Experiência com planejamento de compras e abastecimento;
  • Conhecimento de sistemas ERP, especialmente TOTVS Protheus;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de BI;
  • Experiência na liderança ou coordenação de equipes.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Perfil analítico e estratégico;
  • Visão de negócio;

title: Senior Warehouse Supervisor - Guarulhos
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!

About the job

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Warehouse Supervisor to oversee daily logistics operations within a business unit, ensuring operational efficiency, productivity, quality, and compliance with established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

This role will be responsible for coordinating warehouse activities across Receiving, Stocking, Shipping, Sorting, and Inventory , ensuring that operational processes are executed effectively and that teams are properly guided and supported to achieve business objectives.

The professional will also play an important role in monitoring operational performance, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement, solving operational issues, and implementing corrective actions to enhance overall warehouse performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supervise daily logistics operations within the assigned business unit, ensuring activities are completed within established deadlines and quality standards.
  • Lead and engage employees in compliance with Occupational Health and Safety, Quality, and Environmental policies , as well as company standards and procedures.
  • Ensure the effective execution and maintenance of existing operational processes, while proactively identifying opportunities for improvement and greater efficiency.
  • Oversee key warehouse activities, including Receiving, Stocking, Shipping, Sorting, and Inventory , prioritizing and distributing tasks according to operational needs.
  • Provide guidance and support to the team, addressing operational challenges and resolving issues that may impact productivity, quality, or service levels.
  • Monitor operational progress and performance, identifying deviations and implementing corrective actions to ensure compliance with SLAs, productivity targets, and quality standards .
  • Track and analyze key operational performance indicators (KPIs), using data and logistics studies to identify trends, operational gaps, and opportunities to improve overall warehouse performance.
  • Coordinate physical inventory activities, ensuring proper execution and taking the necessary actions to maintain inventory accuracy.
  • Contribute to the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of quality standards within the area of responsibility.
  • Provide regular feedback, guidance, and performance insights to leaders and coordinators, supporting team development and operational excellence.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure alignment between logistics operations and broader business requirements.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Engineering, Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management , or a related field.
  • 3+ years of professional experience in logistics or supply chain, preferably with experience in logistics operations, continuous improvement, distribution, supply chain, or demand planning.
  • Previous experience supervising or coordinating logistics or warehouse operations.
  • Strong problem-solving and data analysis skills , with the ability to interpret operational data and make sound, data-driven decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify operational inefficiencies and implement practical solutions to improve productivity, quality, and service levels.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with customers, peers, direct reports, and cross-functional stakeholders .
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities while maintaining operational excellence.
  • Advanced English proficiency .
  • Availability to work shifts in Guarulhos .

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in large-scale warehouse, fulfillment, distribution center, or e-commerce operations.
  • Experience with KPI management, operational performance analysis, inventory accuracy, and continuous improvement initiatives .
  • Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Experience working in high-volume and rapidly changing logistics environments.

title: AI Operations
description:
About Liora

Liora is an energy fintech: we operate distributed generation assets across Brazil and turn the savings they generate on clients' electricity bills into financial products, credit, cashback and benefits, without increasing what clients pay.

Most people treat their electricity bill as a fixed, unavoidable cost, something you pay and forget.

What they don't realize is that energy has all the characteristics of a financial asset: it's recurring, predictable, and present in virtually every household and business budget. Liora was built on that insight.

The electricity bill stops being a burden and becomes a channel for economic opportunity, especially for the small businesses that traditional finance has always underserved.

We're building an AI-first operation where agents score credit & risk, approve or decline applications, and run ownership transfers across dozens of energy distributors.

This is not an automation project. It is a real business operation with real clients, real volume and real consequences, designed from day one to be run by AI agents.

We are looking for the person who will make it work.

What you'll operate

Credit & Risk

Deciding who is a good payer, who is too risky, and under what terms we should accept each client.

  • Define and apply credit & risk criteria: evaluate payment behavior, energy consumption and other signals to determine approval, limits and risk.
  • Run and improve the operation:m onitor decisions, portfolio health, default rates and edge cases, turning learnings into better rules and processes.
  • Own the AI agents: define how they analyze applications, what they handle autonomously and where they escalate to you.

Ownership Transfer

Getting every new consumer unit (UC) fully switched over to Liora across dozens of distributors with different rules and systems.

  • Own the process: map distributor requirements and ensure contracts and documentation are correct.
  • Run and unblock the operation: track transfers, resolve rejections and exceptions, and keep applications moving.
  • Own the AI agents: automate execution, define escalation points and continuously expand what agents can handle.

These are complex, high-volume operations that, in the traditional model, would require large teams. At Liora, we want them run by agents, with you in command.

Who you are

We care less about titles and years of experience than about how you think, learn and solve problems.

You don't need to have done this before. Very few people have. We're looking for someone early enough in their career to be excited by building something from scratch, but ambitious enough to take real ownership from day one.

Degree and industry background don't matter. What matters is that you can move between business judgment and technical execution: understand the problem, build the solution, measure the result and improve it.

You're not waiting for a defined process or formal training to get started. You enjoy figuring things out when there is no obvious answer.

You spend time experimenting with AI agents because you're genuinely curious. You've tested tools, broken things, understood why they broke and tried again.

Why now, why Liora

The energy sector is full of opaque tariffs, fragmented processes and decades of accumulated complexity. Liora is turning that complexity into financial infrastructure for SMBs and high-consumption consumers.

We're backed by Canary, 17Sigma and 468 Capital. We doubled in size in the first two months of 2026 and project 15x growth by year end.

You'll join while the category is being created, with the autonomy to build the playbook as you go.

The window is open. It won't stay that way forever.

title: Pesquisador Doutor - Comercial Agrícola Anhumaí - Segurança Microbiológica na Cadeia do Amido - Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial | IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .

Sobre a Oportunidade:

A Comercial Agrícola Anhumaí Ltda atua na cadeia produtiva do amido de mandioca, com foco na qualidade, segurança e conformidade do produto final. Em um setor que exige controle rigoroso, a empresa busca aprimorar seus processos para reduzir riscos microbiológicos e atender aos limites estabelecidos pela legislação vigente.

Neste projeto, a atuação será voltada à avaliação de fontes de contaminação por Bacillus cereus, analisando dados desde a matéria-prima no campo até o produto final estocado. O objetivo é identificar pontos críticos e desenvolver estratégias de controle que fortaleçam a segurança e a qualidade do amido de mandioca.

Se você tem perfil analítico, interesse em microbiologia, qualidade e segurança de alimentos, essa é uma oportunidade para contribuir com melhorias técnicas e gerar impacto direto na cadeia produtiva.

Projeto:

Avaliação de fontes de contaminação microbiológica e desenvolvimento de estratégias de controle de Bacillus Cereus em amidos de mandioca.

Formação Acadêmica: Doutorado em Microbiologia, Ciência de Alimentos, Engenharia de Alimentos, Engenharia Química, Biotecnologia, Bioquímica ou áreas correlatas .

Principais Atividades:

  • Relatórios técnicos periódicos;
  • Protocolos de monitoramento e controle microbiológico;
  • Pareceres técnicos;
  • Procedimentos operacionais para mitigação da contaminação por Bacillus cereus ;
  • Relatório final consolidado do projeto.
  • Monitoramento microbiológico do processo produtivo.

Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos:

  • Conhecimento em microbiologia de alimentos;
  • Métodos de análise microbiológica e interpretação de resultados;
  • Análise de dados aplicada ao monitoramento microbiológico.

Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre Bacillus cereus ;
  • Ferramentas de qualidade e melhoria contínua, como APPCC e ciclo PDCA;
  • Desejável conhecimento em legislação sanitária aplicável a alimentos;
  • Conhecimento do processo de produção de amido de mandioca ou processos correlacionados.

Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

Formato de trabalho : Presencial / Tamboara - PR

Soft Skills : Trabalho em equipe, Pensamento crítico, Proatividade e organização.

title: Import Specialist
description:
About Meelunie

Meelunie is a global supplier of agricultural ingredients—specializing in plant-based starches, proteins, and sweeteners for food, feed, and industrial applications. Headquartered in Amsterdam, our global footprint spans offices across Europe, Asia, Australia, and the Americas.

As we scale our operations via Meelunie Do Brasil, we are expanding our local footprint to support key global accounts and build out our long-term distribution network across the region.

Position Overview

We are seeking an autonomous, proactive Import Specialist to take full operational ownership of our inbound container shipments into Brazil.

Reporting directly to global logistics leadership, you will oversee the complete ocean import lifecycle: from origin booking to customs release and final warehouse arrival. Because you will be joining a lean local setup supported by external providers, success in this role requires high self-reliance, rigorous attention to regulatory deadlines, and a drive to solve delays before they happen.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor container shipments end-to-end immediately post-departure, tracking carrier schedules, container positions, and updated ETAs to maintain real-time visibility.
  • Act as the main driver for customs clearance once cargo touches Brazilian ports, directly managing and expediting clearances involving MAPA and ANVISA to ensure rapid container release.
  • Supervise external customs brokers and local service partners, driving proactive follow-ups rather than waiting for status updates to avoid costly demurrage, detention, and storage fees.
  • Work closely with international trading desks in Europe, overseas sourcing teams, and domestic partners while adapting seamlessly across different business cultures and time zones.
  • Coordinate with our outsourced warehouse and freight partners in Brazil to hand off cleared inventory efficiently.

Requirements & Competencies

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in ocean container imports in Brazil.
  • Professional Portuguese and English fluency (the recruitment process and daily international communications will be conducted in English)
  • Demonstrated experience with Brazilian customs procedures and import regulations.
  • Strong knowledge of MAPA and ANVISA procedures and requirements.
  • Experience managing import operations through Santa Catarina and São Paulo.
  • Experience working with shipping lines, customs brokers, port authorities and warehouse operators.
  • Knowledge of Incoterms and international trade documentation.
  • Experience with ERP systems; experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 (F&O) is preferred.
  • Ability to process and audit import documentation accurately.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent organizational and planning skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple import files simultaneously.

What We Offer

Joining Meelunie Do Brasil offers a flexible work setup built on trust, total ownership, and true operational autonomy. You will have a direct impact on building and scaling local logistics processes for a globally recognized trading entity, taking full charge of your work while gaining valuable daily exposure to dynamic, international commercial and supply chain teams.

title: Analista Operacional Pleno
description:
Sobre o Grupo BCP Securities

Fundada em 1989, a BCP Securities, Inc. é uma corretora e banco de investimento americano com foco em renda fixa em mercados emergentes. Com sede em Greenwich, Connecticut, e escritórios em cidades estratégicas como Rio de Janeiro, Miami, Los Angeles, Madrid, Cidade do México e Singapura, a BCP é referência global em soluções financeiras personalizadas. Reconhecida por sua excelência e compromisso ético, a empresa oferece serviços inovadores e eficazes para atender às necessidades de clientes ao redor do mundo.

Sobre a BCP DTVM

A BCP DTVM é uma instituição financeira voltada para originação, estruturação e distribuição de ativos financeiros, com destaque para crédito privado e operações estruturadas. Nossa atuação inclui uma mesa ativa de negociações no mercado secundário, promovendo liquidez e transparência para os clientes.

Expandindo do mercado offshore para o mercado local, a BCP DTVM combina expertise técnica e agilidade, atendendo empresas, investidores institucionais e family offices com soluções sólidas e inovadoras. Somos o lugar certo para profissionais que buscam um ambiente dinâmico e orientado a resultados, contribuindo para o futuro do mercado financeiro brasileiro.

Local de Trabalho : cidade do Rio de Janeiro, 100% presencial

Tipo de Contrato : CLT

  • Realizar a liquidação e reconciliação diária de operações de renda fixa e crédito privado, com foco em debêntures, CRIs, CRAs, notas promissórias e demais títulos;

title: Analista de Contabilidade PL
description:
Com 180 anos de história, seguimos em expansão. Buscamos pessoas que sustentem o nosso legado nos negócios com visão orientada para uma constante evolução tecnológica.

Aqui você encontrará uma instituição feita de pessoas, norteada por meritocracia, integridade, agilidade, diligência e perenidade. Nossa equipe conta com uma grande diversidade geracional e de experiências, que nos dá a possibilidade aprender muito e seguir inovando com o objetivo de proporcionar a nossa excelência em serviços para todos os clientes.

Analista Contabilidade Pleno

A equipe de Contabilidade atua na asseguração contábil das operações de Crédito e Meios de Pagamento, com missão de garantir que cada transação esteja correta, rastreável e em plena conformidade regulatória — da origem ao balanço.

Com atuação pautada em rigor técnico, controle e conformidade, a área é responsável por:

Conduzir reconciliações e controles entre sistemas operacionais e a contabilidade oficial

Validar receitas e monitorar carteiras de Crédito e Meios de Pagamento

Assegurar aderência plena às normas do BACEN e aos padrões IFRS

Identificar e sanear divergências com visão sistêmica dos processos

Promover automação e eficiência operacional por meio da melhoria contínua

Em sua atuação, o profissional irá:

  • Rastrear o ciclo de vida das transações, validando integrações entre sistemas legados e o razão contábil
  • Conduzir reconciliações e investigações de causa raiz de divergências, garantindo o saneamento de pendências

  • Apoiar projetos de melhoria contínua e automação, reduzindo retrabalho e fortalecendo controles

Requisitos:

  • Formação em Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou Administração
  • Experiência comprovada em reconciliações contábeis e análise de grandes volumes transacionais
  • Conhecimento das normas BACEN e padrões IFRS aplicados ao segmento financeiro
  • Vivência no rastreamento e validação de integrações entre sistemas legados e razão contábil
  • Capacidade de identificar, classificar e tratar breaks contábeis e operacionais
  • Experiência com validação de receitas (juros, tarifas, interchange) e acompanhamento de carteiras

Diferenciais
