  • Trabalhe proativamente para resolver desafios de desempenho, escalabilidade e disponibilidade, garantindo suporte para trabalho remoto e híbrido.
  • Colabore com TI, segurança, negócios e operações para alinhar as demandas e promover a melhor experiência do usuário final.
  • Promover uma governança eficaz, cumprindo as regulamentações globais (LGPD, GDPR, PIPEDA) e as políticas internas.
  • Produzir documentação completa, guias, planos de contingência, treinamentos e melhores práticas para equipes de apoio e operações.
  • Participe de fóruns, workshops e projetos de inovação para manter o ambiente tecnológico alinhado com as tendências globais.

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas similares.
  • Sólida experiência (mínimo 8 anos) em arquitetura, gestão e inovação do ambiente de Computação para Usuários Finais, em empresas globais ou setores altamente complexos.
  • Conhecimento avançado em plataformas e ferramentas EUC: Microsoft 365, Windows Desktop, macOS, VDI (Citrix, VMware Horizon), MDM (Intune, MobileIron), ferramentas de colaboração (Teams, Zoom).

  • Experiência com ambientes de trabalho híbridos e remotos, suporte técnico avançado e estratégias para maximizar produtividade e segurança.

Inglês fluente para comunicação técnica global, português avançado para alinhamento Brasil-Canadá.

  • Experiência específica no setor de mineração, transformação digital ou grandes iniciativas globais.

title: Analista de Crédito e Cobrança Pleno
description:
A AutoZone é a maior rede varejista de autopeças e acessórios automotivos do mundo ! Empresa Americana, estamos em plena expansão no Brasil, com mais de 149 lojas no país.

A AutoZone inaugurou sua primeira loja AutoZone do Brasil na cidade de Sorocaba em setembro de 2012. Esteja você ajudando clientes ou construindo sua carreira, fornecemos ferramentas e suporte para ajudá-lo a ter sucesso e impulsionar seu futuro.

Com mais de 7.000 lojas em operação e presença consolidada em diversos países, a AutoZone é uma referência global no setor de autopeças e acessórios automotivos. No Brasil, seguimos em ritmo acelerado de expansão, com operações em sete estados: São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Bahia, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná e Goiás.

Valorizamos a diversidade e acreditamos em ambientes inclusivos. Todas as pessoas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, idade ou deficiência, são bem-vindas para se candidatar.

Descrição Resumida:

Auxilia nas atividades de análise de crédito, faturamento, contas a receber e cobrança, atuando sob supervisão para garantir o processamento preciso e pontual das transações de crédito e contas a receber. Contribui para a eficiência e eficácia das operações do departamento.

Responsabilidades:

  • Foco maior em Cobrança.

Isso pode envolver o envio de lembretes, negociação de prazos e escalonamento de cobranças, quando necessário. Outras atividades de apoio à cobrança envolvem enviar relatórios de acompanhamento para as lojas e preparar envio de cartas de anuência.
  • Apoio na análise de crédito: Responsável pela análise da capacidade de crédito dos clientes e na tomada de decisões com base nas políticas e procedimentos estabelecidos. Isso envolve a revisão de relatórios de crédito, demonstrações financeiras e históricos de pagamento para avaliar o risco de crédito, fazer liberação emergencial de limite de crédito, realizar validação e revisão cadastral dos clientes, realizar bloqueio e desbloqueio de cadastro conforme política interna.
  • Faturamento: Atuar no processo de faturamento, enviando faturas aos clientes de forma precisa e pontual. Isso inclui verificar as informações de cobrança, aplicar descontos ou ajustes apropriados e resolver divergências de faturamento.

title: Gerente de contas
description:

title: Pessoa Estagiária de Engenharia - Indicadores
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Coordenação do time de Marketing e elaboração do planejamento estratégico anual;

  • Gerenciamento do planejamento, junto da agência de mídia nacional e assessoria de imprensa;
  • Desenvolvimento de projetos especiais focados em implementação de novas frentes de trabalho, prospecção de eventos, captação de patrocínio;
  • Acompanhamento, mapeamento e implementação de melhorias dentro da vertical de mídia no shopping;
  • Gerenciamento da performance de mídia paga e CRM, Programas de benefícios do shopping, envolvendo definição da objetivos, estratégia, implementação, acompanhamento, relatório de resultados e KPIs estratégicos.

title: 3D Character Animator
description:
3D Character Animator - Indie Platform Fighter

I'm looking to hire an experienced 3D Character Animator to help bring the fighters in an upcoming indie platform fighter to life.

The game is a fast-paced, combat-focused platform fighter featuring gods, deities, and religious figures from different traditions battling one another. I'm looking for someone who can create dynamic, highly readable, hard-hitting combat animation , with attacks that feel powerful, responsive, expressive, and satisfying in gameplay.

What I'm Looking For

Required

  • Strong professional portfolio demonstrating 3D character animation
  • Ideally 5–10+ years of 3D animation experience
  • Experience working on indie games or other real-time game projects
  • Excellent understanding of:
  • Combat animation
  • Body mechanics
  • Weight and momentum
  • Timing, anticipation, follow-through, and impact
  • Exaggerated poses and readable silhouettes
  • Ability to create everything from quick jabs and movement animations to large, epic special attacks and finishing moves
  • Understanding of the technical constraints of animation for real-time gameplay
  • Comfortable iterating based on how animations actually feel in-game

Strongly Preferred

  • Cascadeur
  • Blender
  • Unity
  • Experience exporting animation assets and implementing/testing them inside Unity
Bonus Skills

I'd especially love to find someone capable of handling more of the full 3D character pipeline , including:

  • Retopology (for minor clean-up work)
  • UV unwrapping
  • Texturing
  • Rigging (especially for animals, or characters with multiple arms or wings)
  • Weight painting
  • Character and animal animation
  • Preparing/exporting characters and animations for Unity
  • Troubleshooting rigs, meshes, animation clips, and import settings

These additional skills are a major plus, but animation is the priority . If you're an exceptional combat animator who specializes specifically in animation, I still want to hear from you.

The Project

This is an indie platform fighter built around a roster of mythological and religious characters, with an intentionally comedic, irreverent, and satirical tone.

Important: The game contains deliberately blasphemous and sacrilegious humor and jokes about gods, religions, religious beliefs, and religious figures. Applicants need to be genuinely comfortable working on that kind of material.

Who Would Be a Great Fit

I'm looking for someone who:

  • Loves making combat animation feel ridiculously satisfying
  • Understands that gameplay readability matters as much as beautiful animation
  • Can exaggerate movement without making it feel weightless
  • Is comfortable working collaboratively and iterating quickly
  • Has experience with small or independent game-development teams
  • Can take a relatively simple stylized character and give them a huge amount of personality through movement
  • If you've worked on a fighting game, platform fighter, action game, or anything involving exaggerated character combat, I'd especially like to see it.

description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Objetivo da Posição

Buscamos um profissional com sólida experiência em Planejamento Financeiro (FP&A), fechamento gerencial e gestão de indicadores financeiros, com forte atuação no acompanhamento e controle de covenants financeiros , endividamento corporativo e indicadores de alavancagem. Este (a) profissional será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade das informações financeiras, suportar a tomada de decisão da liderança e assegurar a aderência às obrigações financeiras e contratuais da companhia.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Realizar o fechamento gerencial das concessões e holdings do grupo, assegurando a qualidade e consistência das informações financeiras.
  • Monitorar e controlar os covenants financeiros previstos em contratos de dívida, garantindo o cumprimento das obrigações contratuais e antecipando potenciais riscos de descumprimento.
  • Acompanhar indicadores financeiros relacionados ao endividamento e à alavancagem, incluindo Dívida Líquida, EBITDA, Dívida Líquida/EBITDA e cobertura de juros.
  • Elaborar análises de realizado versus orçamento e forecast, identificando desvios, causas e impactos no desempenho financeiro.
  • Consolidar informações financeiras de diferentes empresas e estruturas societárias do grupo.
  • Participar da elaboração, atualização e acompanhamento de forecasts mensais, projeções financeiras e análises de cenários.
  • Atuar no controle e acompanhamento de contratos de financiamento e demais instrumentos de dívida corporativa.
  • Desenvolver materiais gerenciais e apresentações executivas para reporte à alta liderança e suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Apoiar a validação de informações contábeis e financeiras relacionadas aos indicadores monitorados.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos financeiros, controles internos e modelos de análise.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida em Planejamento Financeiro (FP&A ) , fechamento gerencial e consolidação financeira.
  • Vivência comprovada com controle e monitoramento de covenants financeiros , endividamento corporativo e indicadores de alavancagem.
  • Conhecimento em análise de demonstrativos financeiros, fluxo de caixa, projeções financeiras e construção de cenários.
  • Experiência na elaboração de análises de realizado versus orçamento e forecast.
  • Conhecimento em contratos de dívida, financiamentos e estrutura de capital.
  • Excel Avançado.
  • Power BI (desejável).
  • Power Query (desejável).
  • Conhecimento em SAP, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) ou ferramentas similares (desejável).

Formação

  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Finanças, Controladoria ou áreas afins será considerado um diferencial.

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .

Necessário:

  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Structural Analysis Engineer - Mid Level
description:
Summary Description

We are looking for a Mid-Level Structural Analysis Engineer to support aerospace and/or aeronautical engineering projects, with a focus on metallic and/or composite structures. The engineer will be responsible for performing static analysis, fatigue analysis, and damage tolerance evaluations to support product development, certification, modifications, and in-service support activities.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in structural calculations, interpretation of technical requirements, engineering drawings, finite element modeling, and technical report preparation. A solid understanding of strength of materials, structural mechanics, margins of safety, and structural substantiation methods is required.

Key Responsibilities:

- Perform static analysis of aircraft structures using hand calculations and/or finite element methods.

- Support fatigue and structural life assessments under technical guidance.

- Support damage tolerance evaluations, including crack growth assessment and inspection criteria.

- Prepare finite element models, loads, boundary conditions, and basic correlation activities.

- Prepare clear and traceable technical reports aligned with certification requirements.

- Interface with design, loads, materials, certification, manufacturing, and product support teams.

Desired Qualifications:

- Degree in Aeronautical, Aerospace, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.

- Approximately 4 to 7 years of experience in structural analysis.

- Experience with tools such as Nastran, Patran, FEMAP, HyperMesh, Abaqus, ANSYS, or similar.

- Experience with metallic and/or composite aircraft structures.

- Knowledge of static strength, fatigue, damage tolerance, structural margins, and certification documentation.

- Technical English for reading, report writing, and engineering communication.

title: Senior AI Solutions Sales
description:
On behalf of Huawei, a world-renowned it and communications company, we are looking for Senior AI Solutions Sales Specialist talents.

Please see the position details below:

We are hiring experienced local professionals in Brazil and Mexico to develop and win AI computing opportunities with large enterprise customers. This is a customer-facing solution sales role with strong pre-sales ownership: you will identify and qualify opportunities, lead technical discovery, shape the solution and competitive strategy, drive PoCs and tenders, and support the account team through commercial closure and handover.

Key Responsibilities

1. Opportunity Development & Account Shaping : Partner with account managers to build and qualify the AI computing pipeline. Identify customer priorities, use cases, stakeholders, decision criteria, budget and procurement path; convert early-stage needs into actionable opportunities and account plans.

2. Customer Discovery & Solution Architecture : Lead technical and business discovery workshops. Translate AI training, inference, HPC and enterprise workloads into end-to-end architectures covering compute, accelerators, cluster topology, storage, networking, operating systems, containers and hybrid-cloud integration. Define sizing, capacity, availability, security and expansion assumptions.

3. Technical Influence, Workshops & PoCs : Present solutions to C-level executives, technical decision-makers and architecture teams. Build customer-specific demonstrations, PoC plans and benchmark criteria; coordinate resources, track results and close technical gaps. Explain trade-offs in a clear, commercially relevant way.

4. Bid, Tender & Commercial Support : Own or contribute to RFI/RFP responses, solution blueprints, Bills of Materials (BoM), compliance matrices, Statements of Work and TCO/business-case inputs. Support public tenders and enterprise procurement, address technical objections and help the sales team position a competitive, executable offer.

5. Ecosystem & Competitive Strategy : Work with local system integrators, ISVs, cloud partners and data-center partners to complete the solution. Track competing AI and infrastructure platforms, customer incumbent environments and ecosystem dependencies; develop practical migration, interoperability and differentiation strategies.

6. Deal Closure & Handover : Stay engaged through negotiation and closure to protect solution scope and feasibility. After award, hand over the agreed architecture, assumptions, commitments, risks and PoC findings to delivery and support teams, and maintain continuity with the customer.

Job Requirements & Professional Knowledge:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electrical/Electronic Engineering or a related technical discipline.

• 8+ years of experience in enterprise infrastructure, cloud, data-center solutions, solution architecture, pre-sales or technical solution sales; at least 5 years in a customer-facing role in the assigned local market.

• Demonstrated experience selling or designing AI computing, accelerated computing, HPC or large-scale server/platform solutions.

• Strong understanding of enterprise server platforms, CPU architectures (including x86 and ARM), AI accelerators/GPUs/NPUs, cluster design, storage and data-center networking.

• Working knowledge of AI workload fundamentals, including training vs. inference, distributed computing, model deployment, performance bottlenecks and the mainstream AI software ecosystem. Deep model-development or data-science coding expertise is not required.

• Hands-on familiarity with Linux and cloud-native infrastructure, including RHEL or equivalent enterprise Linux, Kubernetes/OpenShift or comparable container platforms, and hybrid-cloud integration patterns.

• Proven ability to lead technical discovery, solution sizing, customer presentations, PoCs, RFP/RFI responses, BoM development and TCO/business-case discussions.

• Strong executive communication and stakeholder-management skills. Able to work with business leaders, procurement teams and technical specialists without losing technical depth or commercial focus.

• Ability to work independently across a multi-country organization and travel within the assigned country/LATAM when customer engagements require it.

title: Service Product Sales Engineer (Energy Storage)
description:
Summary

As an Overseas Service Sales Engineer, you will be responsible for promoting and selling the company's energy storage operation and maintenance service products in designated overseas markets. You will directly engage with end customers, channel partners, and project developers to drive the signing and execution of service contracts. A deep understanding of customer needs is essential to provide tailored solutions leveraging the company's service product strengths. You will collaborate closely with internal technical, project, and support teams to ensure customer success, contribute to achieving regional sales targets, and strengthen the company's competitiveness in the overseas energy storage services market.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Sales Target Execution & Client Development:
  2. 1.1. Execute team-defined regional service product sales strategies and action plans. Actively develop new clients and maintain existing client relationships to achieve individual sales targets (e.g., contract value, collection rate).
  3. 1.2. Independently manage the full sales cycle from opportunity identification, service requirement analysis, solution presentation, and negotiation to the signing of service contracts (e.g., LTSA, ASSA), with a focus on long-term service projects for energy storage plant O&M, operations, and asset management.
  4. Customer Insight & Solution Customization:
  5. 2.1. Conduct in-depth research on customer pain points, industry standards, and policy environments in key overseas target markets (e.g., Europe & Americas, APAC). Provide timely feedback on market trends and competitive intelligence.
  6. 2.2. Collaborate with the Solution Department to provide customers with suitable O&M service product portfolios (e.g., extended warranty, remote monitoring, preventive maintenance, performance optimization, assessment, supplementation). Lead technical discussions and service proposal presentations.
  7. Key Account & Channel Collaboration:
  8. 3.1. Assist the Sales Manager in maintaining relationships with regional strategic key accounts and channel partners. Participate in joint visits, technical workshops, and commercial negotiations.
  9. 3.2. Explore ecosystem partnership opportunities (e.g., with EPC contractors, energy operators) to expand service product coverage through partner networks.
  10. Cross-functional Collaboration & Project Support:
  11. 4.1. Work closely with Product, Project Management, Technical, and Service Delivery teams to ensure service solution feasibility. Facilitate smooth handover post-contract signing and track customer satisfaction.
  12. 4.2. Regularly relay customer feedback to internal teams, providing frontline input for service product optimization.
  13. Sales Process & Data Management:
  14. 5.1. Strictly utilize the CRM system to record sales activities, update pipeline data, and maintain customer information, ensuring forecast accuracy and process compliance.
  15. 5.2. Participate in team sales reviews. Analyze data to summarize win/loss experiences and market obstacles, supporting team strategy adjustments.
  16. Compliance & Risk Management:
  17. 6.1. Adhere to company overseas business compliance policies and local laws & regulations. Ensure contract terms and commercial activities meet risk control requirements. Promptly report potential risks.

Qualifications:

Must-to-Have:

  1. Bachelor's degree or higher. Engineering (Electrical, Energy, Automation, etc.) or Business background preferred.
  2. Minimum 3 years of B2B sales experience. Experience in service sales within new energy, energy storage, power, or industrial services preferred. Experience in overseas markets (especially Europe & Americas, Australia/New Zealand, Japan/Korea) is a plus.
  3. Familiarity with fundamental service technologies for energy storage systems, O&M/operations processes, or plant asset management models. Ability to communicate customer service needs effectively with technical teams.
  4. Proven track record of independently achieving sales targets. Practical experience in selling service-type products (e.g., subscription-based, long-term agreements) is required.
  5. Proficient in using CRM and office software; possesses basic data analysis skills.
  6. Fluent in English and Local Language (written and spoken). Knowledge of Chinese is a plus.

Soft Skills & Attributes:

  1. Customer-centric & Solution-oriented: Skilled at uncovering latent customer needs, translating product value into customer language, and providing targeted solutions.
  2. Self-driven & Resilient: Capable of proactively driving work in a goal-oriented, cross-time-zone collaborative environment. Maintains resilience under performance pressure.
  3. Cross-cultural Communication & Collaboration: Adapts to multicultural environments. Able to build trust and collaborate effectively with overseas clients and internal global teams.
  4. Learning & Adaptability: Stays attuned to changes in energy storage industry technology and business models. Quickly grasps new product and service logic.
  5. Integrity & Compliance Awareness: Upholds business ethics. Strictly adheres to company compliance processes, safeguarding the company's brand reputation.

Additional Notes:

  • This position requires frequent travel (approximately 30%-50% of the time) to cover designated overseas regional clients and project sites.
  • The company provides product training, sales methodology coaching, and overseas market resource support to facilitate employee growth.

A Trivia é a concessionária do Grupo Comporte responsável pela futura operação e manutenção das Linhas 11–Coral, 12–Safira e 13–Jade de trens metropolitanos de São Paulo, conhecido como Lote Alto Tietê. Localizadas na Zona Leste da capital paulista, as linhas atendem mais de 4,6 milhões de pessoas, sendo um dos principais eixos de deslocamento diário da cidade.

Além da operação e manutenção, a Trivia assumirá a modernização do sistema ferroviário da região. Entre as responsabilidades da concessionária estão a ampliação e revitalização de estações, a requalificação da infraestrutura existente e o fechamento de passagens em nível, garantindo mais segurança e conforto para os passageiros.

#TriviaTrens #grupocomporte #oportunidades

title: Strategy & Operations Manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.

We're looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to help shape how we continue to expand and operate across the globe. You’ll work on high-impact initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers.

Watch this video from our team members about what goes into being a Strategy & Operations Manager at Revolut.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you’ll be doing

  • Building and optimising scalable processes to continue Revolut's hyper-growth
  • Leading and executing core infrastructure projects
  • Exploring and defining which projects the team should prioritise, and setting a timeline to reach goals quickly
  • Searching for new features to provide a seamless customer experience
  • Managing critical vendor relationships and building performance tracking systems
  • Developing strategic supply chain partnerships and negotiating commercial terms

What you'll need

  • At least a 2:1 degree from a top university
  • 4+ years of work experience in a fast-paced environment
  • A solid track record of taking ownership and leading complex projects end to end
  • A magic skill to break complex problems into smaller ones
  • To enjoy working with data
  • Natural curiosity and a will to make an impact
  • An interest in the financial industry

Nice to have

  • Experience coding with SQL, Python, or R

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. title: Safety Assurance Head - Banc
description:
Na ArcelorMittal acreditamos que uma escolha de carreira vai além da posição, é sobre fazer parte de um ambiente que valoriza pessoas, promove o desenvolvimento contínuo e, acima de tudo, coloca a Segurança como um valor inegociável em todas as decisões.

A seguir, você encontrará mais detalhes sobre a ArcelorMittal, a oportunidade, o que oferecemos e o que buscamos nas pessoas que querem construir essa jornada conosco.

Quem somos

Somos a ArcelorMittal, maior produtora de aço do Brasil e uma empresa global que atua com o propósito de produzir aços inteligentes para as pessoas e para o planeta. Somos uma organização que evolui continuamente, impulsionada por pessoas, inovação e pela busca constante por soluções mais eficientes e sustentáveis. A ArcelorMittal é uma das principais empresas integradas de aço e mineração do mundo, com operações em 60 países e produção primária de aço em 15. Com mais de 125.000 empregados no mundo, atendemos clientes em diversos setores, como automotivo, construção, energia e engenharia. Nossos produtos fazem parte do dia a dia, causando um impacto positivo em indivíduos, comunidades e na sociedade.

Na nossa cultura, as pessoas estão no centro de tudo o que fazemos e é por isso que a Segurança, nosso valor fundamental, orienta nossas ações, decisões e a forma como trabalhamos todos os dias.

Fazer parte da ArcelorMittal é integrar um ambiente em constante transformação, onde:

A segurança e o cuidado com as pessoas vêm sempre em primeiro lugar

  • A inovação e a tecnologia são aplicadas para gerar valor com responsabilidade
  • O aprendizado é contínuo, com desafios reais e oportunidades de crescimento
  • A diversidade de perspectivas fortalece nossas decisões e resultados

Buscamos pessoas que queiram evoluir junto com a empresa, contribuindo de forma responsável, colaborativa e comprometida com resultados sustentáveis.

Você será responsável por:

  • Liderar e evoluir a estratégia de auditorias de Saúde & Segurança e PSM para a região BANC.
  • Desenvolver, implementar e manter a metodologia de auditoria da 3ª Linha de Defesa , assegurando conformidade com ISO 45001 , GIAS e demais padrões técnicos aplicáveis.
  • Atuar como referência estratégica e técnica , fortalecendo a governança e a consistência das auditorias regionais.
  • Definir e executar o plano regional de auditorias baseado em riscos .
  • Liderar auditorias complexas, coordenando equipes internas e especialistas externos.
  • Assegurar a qualidade, clareza e efetividade dos relatórios , bem como o acompanhamento dos planos de ação.
  • Desenvolver a capacitação técnica da equipe por meio de treinamentos em sistemas de gestão de segurança .
  • Apoiar e influenciar na tomada de decisão e na comunicação de temas críticos de Saúde & Segurança (PSM) .

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Segurança do Trabalho ou áreas correlatas.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Sólida experiência em auditorias de Saúde & Segurança e PSM , preferencialmente em ambientes industriais complexos.
  • Vivência em posições de liderança técnica ou gerencial .
  • Conhecimento aprofundado de ISO 45001 , auditorias baseadas em risco e governança.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

Benefícios:

  • Contamos com um pacote de remuneração compatível com o mercado.
  • Programa de Participação de Resultados/Remuneração Variável.
  • Retorno de férias.
  • Horário Flexível.
  • Opção do plano Previdência Privada.
  • Kit Escolar: Anualmente, a empresa distribui material escolar para os filhos dos empregados, de acordo com o nível de escolaridade e a faixa etária (de 3 a 18 anos).
  • Kit de Natal para nossos empregados e suas famílias.

Como funciona nosso processo seletivo?

Nosso processo seletivo é conduzido de forma estruturada, transparente e respeitosa, considerando tanto aspectos técnicos quanto a aderência à nossa cultura. Ao longo da jornada, buscamos conhecer não apenas suas experiências, mas também como você se conecta com ambientes que valorizam:

  • Segurança
  • Cuidado coletivo
  • Responsabilidade nas decisões

Esta é a etapa inicial do processo. Conforme avance, as demais etapas incluem entrevistas com o time de Pessoas e com a liderança, além de avaliações complementares ao longo do processo e ao final, etapa admissional.

Estamos muito felizes com o seu interesse em se juntar ao nosso #TIMAÇO e esperamos receber a sua candidatura. Para saber mais sobre a gente, acesse nossas redes sociais.

title: Product Analyst - Vmake · Brazil
description:
Why We Need You

We’re building an AI-powered video creation platform that empowers creators, brands, and e-commerce sellers to produce high-performing content with ease. As our Product Analyst, you’ll combine product thinking, user research, and data-driven insights to help shape features that resonate with Brazilian creators.

You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, and the creator community to identify opportunities, validate ideas, and ensure our product solves real user problems. Your understanding of short-form video trends, creator workflows, and AI-powered content creation will directly influence our product roadmap.

What You’ll Do

  • Become a power user of Vmake’s AI video tools by testing new features, identifying usability issues, and evaluating the overall creator experience.
  • Analyze user behavior, creator feedback, and product metrics to uncover opportunities for product improvements.
  • Monitor trends across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, and emerging creator platforms, translating market insights into actionable product recommendations.
  • Partner with Product Managers to define product requirements, prioritize enhancements, and support roadmap planning.
  • Conduct competitive research on AI-powered creative tools and video editing platforms, identifying best practices and product gaps.
  • Gather, organize, and synthesize qualitative and quantitative user feedback into clear product recommendations.
  • Collaborate closely with Design and Engineering teams throughout feature discovery, testing, and iteration.
  • Assist in defining success metrics and evaluating feature performance after launch.
  • Create documentation including product briefs, user stories, competitive analyses, and feature specifications.

Who You Are

  • 3–5 years of experience in Product, Product Analysis, Product Operations, or a related product role within SaaS, AI, creator economy, social media, or e-commerce technology.
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian creator ecosystem and short-form video platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and enthusiasm for generative AI technologies.
  • Experience translating customer pain points into clear product requirements.
  • Strong analytical thinking with the ability to interpret both qualitative and quantitative data.
  • Excellent communication skills and experience working cross-functionally with Product, Design, and Engineering.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with changing priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active content creator with a public portfolio or social media presence.
  • Experience with TikTok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, or creator-focused commerce platforms.
  • Experience conducting user interviews, usability testing, or product discovery.
  • Familiarity with wireframing tools such as Figma.
  • Experience using analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA4, or similar platforms.

title: Regulatory and Trade Compliance Lead (Seeds & Traits)
description:
Position Overview

This role leads the import, export, and domestic logistics for biological materials to support the R&D and Regulatory teams in Brazil. Operating initially as a high-level individual contributor, the Regulatory and Trade Compliance Lead will be the technical reference within the company, responsible for designing, compliance-checking, and executing the cross-border and domestic movement of research materials from scratch.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and execute the end-to-end import and export processes biological materials, ensuring full compliance with Brazilian and international trade regulations.
  • Act as the primary technical interface with Brazilian authorities, particularly MAPA (Ministério da Agricultura e Pecuária) managing import permits (LI), and phytosanitary certificates.
  • Oversee and coordinate the secure, compliant domestic transport and logistics of biological materials between R&D sites, laboratories, and field trial sites in Brazil.
  • Partner closely with internal R&D and Regulatory Affairs teams to streamline the flow of materials needed for research, breeding, and biosafety trials.
  • Manage external partners, including customs brokers, specialized logistics providers, and laboratories, to ensure speed and regulatory compliance in all operations.
  • Establish internal standard operating procedures (SOPs) for trade compliance, traceability, and material handling within the organization.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Agronomy, Biology, Biotechnology, International Trade, or related disciplines.
  • Solid hands-on experience in import/export operations within the agricultural sector, with a strong focus on seeds.
  • Deep knowledge of MAPA regulations, phytosanitary requirements, post-entry quarantine procedures, and domestic transit rules for biological materials.
  • Proven ability to work autonomously, build processes from the ground up, and act as a strategic advisor to scientific teams.
  • Fluent in English; Portuguese required.

Sobre a Gruen

Fundada no Brasil em 2020, com sede em São Paulo, a Gruen conta com um time de engenharia atuando tanto localmente quanto na Alemanha o que assegura o desenvolvimento do processo mais eficiente para cada projeto. Nossa missão é entregar a melhor tecnologia para purificação de biogás com o menor consumo de energia entre todos os processos disponíveis no mercado.

Nossas soluções são específicas e feitas sob medida de acordo com a necessidade dos nossos clientes: pré-tratamento do gás, remoção de CO2 e N2, optional CO2 capture and storage ou liquefação, Liquefação de CH4 ou compressão de 250bar – desde o projeto inicial até a gestão da operação da planta, garantindo satisfação total de nossos clientes.

Fabricação e assistência técnica locais resultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência.

Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam a redução da complexidade e de custos.

Nossa motivação é desenvolver soluções viáveis na geração de energia limpa e sustentável para a preservação do nosso planeta e das gerações futuras.

Supervisor Técnico Operacional – Remoto

Atribuições

  • Apoiar as equipes técnicas durante as atividades de montagem, instalação e manutenção em campo.
  • Participar das atividades de startup, comissionamento e colocação em operação dos equipamentos, em conjunto com as equipes mecânica, elétrica e de automação.
  • Ajustar e parametrizar equipamentos elétricos e eletrônicos, garantindo seu correto funcionamento.
  • Auxiliar na verificação das interfaces e da integração entre os diferentes módulos e sistemas da planta.
  • Realizar configuração, testes e suporte em sistemas de comunicação industrial, como Profinet, Profibus, PROFIBUS PA, AS-Interface e outros protocolos aplicáveis.
  • Acompanhar remotamente os principais parâmetros operacionais das plantas de biogás/biometano, identificando desvios de processo, alarmes e condições anormais de operação.
  • Atuar no diagnóstico de falhas considerando a integração entre automação, instrumentação, equipamentos e processo de produção de biogás/biometano.
  • Apoiar a análise de variáveis de processo relacionadas à produção, tratamento, compressão e/ou utilização do biogás/biometano, conforme a configuração de cada planta.
  • Interpretar tendências e históricos de processo para auxiliar na identificação de causas de falhas e na prevenção de paradas operacionais.
  • Ter visão sistêmica da operação da planta, compreendendo a relação entre equipamentos, instrumentos, válvulas, sistemas de controle e as etapas do processo de biogás/biometano.
  • Atuar de forma preventiva na identificação de condições que possam comprometer a disponibilidade, segurança ou eficiência operacional das plantas.

Qualificações

  • Técnico / Engenharia Elétrica, Automação, Instrumentação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento em Autocad, Eplan, programação Siemens e Rockwell.

  • Habilitação categoria B.

.

title: Finance Manager
description:
When you join GAR, you join something bigger. Big in scale, big in opportunities to grow, and big in impact. With over 100,000 employees across 14 countries, spanning Asia, Europe, North America, and South America, Golden Agri-Resources (GAR) is one of the largest agribusinesses in the world. We manage over half a million hectares of palm oil plantations, including smallholder farms, across Indonesia. But our size is only part of the story. Since 1997, we’ve put sustainability at the centre of how we grow, working hand-in-hand with farmers, communities, and partners to deliver food, fuel, and a better future.

We’re a seed-to-shelf business rooted in palm oil, now expanding across other essential crops like sugar, soybean, sunflower, and coconut.

Our people are our edge. We invest in them through global opportunities, cross-border exposure, and continuous learning, because growing a better business starts with growing our people.

Here, your career feeds something meaningful for the planet, people, and generations to come

We are looking for an experienced Finance Manager to join our team in São Paulo, Brazil. In this role, you will oversee all aspects of finance, accounting, tax, legal, IT, and treasury, including financial reporting, budgeting, taxation, cash management, and statutory compliance. You will be responsible for maintaining the full set of ledgers and accounts, managing monthly closing activities, preparing financial and statutory reports, ensuring compliance with applicable local, international, and internal accounting and tax standards, and supporting the timely and accurate consolidation of financial information for Head Office. As a business partner, you will provide data-driven insights to support decision-making and play a key role in building systems, processes, and frameworks from scratch, particularly across finance, tax, legal, and treasury. This is a highly hands-on role, especially during the initial phase, requiring you to personally execute and/or review key finance processes such as payments, bank reconciliations, tax calculations, invoicing, accounting entries, and month-end closing. We are looking for someone who is proactive, improvement-oriented, and solution-driven, with strong analytical and organizational skills, excellent communication abilities, and a collaborative mindset. The ideal candidate will also have the ability to lead, motivate, and develop teams while working effectively in a dynamic and growing environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain all accounting records in the ERP system to ensure accuracy of the general ledger and financial accounts.
  • Lead the monthly and annual financial closing processes through the preparation of standard reports as well as other custom reports as requested.
  • Review and analyse financial statements/records and provide reports and data analysis to various internal stakeholders.
  • Manage day-to-day risk exposures, -reports and -mitigation measures such as insurances, hedges etc. Work with credit team to manage counterpart exposures and follow up on overdue receivables.
  • Ensure adequate liquidity to support the business, support/investigate/expand local or central funding opportunities.
  • Lead the transition of the bookkeeping from external service providers to "in-house".
  • Ensure desired IT platform and relevant key procedures will be implemented.
  • Coordinate and assist finance department in Brazil with the financial record keeping of the activities undertaken in Brazil.
  • Oversee local administrative matters and purchase office supplies and equipment while maintaining appropriate stock levels in a cost-efficient manner.
  • Manage and execute all payments and customer invoicing, including entering payment instructions into the online banking system and coordinating the required approvals to ensure payments are released accurately and within the established deadlines.
  • Prepare and process cash claims and expense reimbursements for the Brazilian team.
  • Advise and assist various departments on accounting, tax and legal compliance by researching and ensuring compliance to applicable internal, national and international rules and regulations.
  • Coordinate external / internal audits and prepare audit requirements.
  • Liaise with central teams in Singapore / Jakarta for ad-hoc queries and analysis requests.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for office managers, IT teams, auditors, accountants, finance managers, and HR teams across other locations in the EU and Americas regions.
  • Act as the first point of contact for external stakeholders such as banks, legal, tax authorities and other regulatory bodies, service providers.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • 8+ years’ relevant experience in accounting, finance and trade control
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian and international accounting, tax and regulatory requirements.
  • Working experience in the Commodity industry
  • Experience with tax, legal, banking
  • Experience with implementing IT systems and consolidation work
  • Proficient with MS Office
  • Experience with ERP software (SAP is an advantage)
  • Experience working in an international environment
  • Experience building & leading a high performing team
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken
  • Fluent in Spanish, both written and spoken is preferred

We Offer

  • An entrepreneurial and international environment where developing opportunities for growth is valued
  • Training opportunities, locally and globally
  • Health insurance
  • Meal support (vale refeição)
  • Transport support/Parking lot (Vale transporte ou vaga de estacionamento)

Please note that we may incorporate an assessment and reference checks in our selection procedures.

title: HRBP
description:
About Us

JD.com is building the world's most trusted technology and supply chain ecosystem. From our innovative roots in China, we have grown into a NASDAQ-listed, Fortune 44 global enterprise serving over 700 million active customers. Powered by advanced logistics networks, innovative technology, and a commitment to integrity, our business spans retail, logistics, technology, and real estate, dedicated to creating a smarter, faster, and more connected way of life. Through our digital intelligent cross-border supply chain and global logistics network, we continue to expand our international footprint, with operations across China, the United States, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, France, Germany, Spain, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and Brazil. You will join JD's overseas HR team, where we value collaboration, encourage ownership, and are committed to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Position Overview

As the HRBP in Brazil, you will serve as the strategic HR partner for JD's Brazil business team, deeply understanding business needs and providing comprehensive HR solutions for Brazilian operations, covering talent acquisition, organizational development, employee relations, and compliance management. Location: São Paulo, Brazil.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Partnership: Partner with business leadership to understand business priorities and provide strategic HR support to enhance organizational performance.
  • Talent Management: Lead talent management processes, including performance reviews, succession planning, and leadership development programs.
  • Recruitment Strategy: Develop and implement effective recruitment strategies to meet JD's staffing needs across business lines in Brazil.
  • Employee Relations: Manage employee relations, ensure a positive work environment, and address performance or behavioral issues in compliance with Brazilian labor law (CLT).
  • Change Management: Support organizational change and transformation initiatives aligned with JD's global vision.
  • Compliance & Benefits: Advise on compensation, benefits, and HR policies, ensuring full compliance with Brazilian Consolidation of Labor Laws (CLT), including severance regulations (FGTS), vacation and 13th-month salary provisions, occupational health and safety standards (NR regulations), and applicable federal labor regulations.
  • Data-Driven Insights: Utilize HR data and analytics to continuously improve HR programs and processes.
  • Culture Building: Promote employee engagement, diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) to strengthen JD's work culture.

Qualifications

  • Experience: Minimum 5 years of HR Business Partner experience; background in cross-border e-commerce, retail, supply chain, or internet industry is preferred.
  • Communication: Fluent in English, both verbally and in writing; proficiency in Portuguese is highly preferred. Strong negotiation skills and the ability to navigate a global corporate structure.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiar with the talent landscape and operational characteristics of the Brazilian and Latin American market, with strong business acumen.
  • Core Competencies: Solid experience in performance management, talent development, employee relations, and organizational development.
  • Stakeholder Management: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust and influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Legal Expertise: Familiarity with Brazilian labor laws, including CLT, FGTS, INSS social security regulations, 13th-month salary (décimo terceiro) provisions, workplace health and safety norms (NR), and the Brazilian Labor Reform (Lei 13.467/2017). Knowledge of Brazilian union negotiations (acordos coletivos) is a plus.

What We Offer

Joining JD means becoming part of a company that seamlessly integrates talent, innovation, and impact. We offer: a competitive market compensation package (including expatriate allowances and benefits), comprehensive commercial insurance and medical coverage in Brazil, broad career development pathways and global project opportunities, an inclusive and diverse work culture where your voice will be heard, and a comprehensive expatriate support system for relocation and cross-cultural adaptation.

JD is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer and make all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Accounting Generalist
description:
The Accounting Generalist, Brazil is an important member of the Regions and Support units (Finance & Administration) teams. The Accounting Generalist will handle the daily accounting, administration and Human Resources processes supporting the Brazil team. You will be responsible for compliance with local tax requirements with the legal team and the Country Director.

You will report to the Regional Accounting Manager, Latin America, in close collaboration with the Country Director.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

Controls and Procedures

  • Implement internal accounting controls and procedures.
  • Provide training regarding accounting/ financial procedures to ensure personnel adherence and accomplish them, including Netsuite Invoice, Netsuite Expense, Netsuite Advances.
  • Maintain an inventory of office assets.
  • Maintain accounting and payroll records and ensure that they are accurate and detailed and archived.

Cashbox and Banks

  • Monitor office cash flow and maintain regular communication about this with Regional Accounting Manager.
  • Coordinate with local staff and prepare the monthly cash flow.
  • Administrate local banking relations, including bank accounts, credit cards, and others.
  • Prepare monthly bank statement reconciliations.

Payroll

  • Coordinate and review monthly payroll to ensure that the payroll calculations are according to local labor laws.
  • Provided feed back to employees regarding payroll calculations and taxes.
  • Prepare and send payroll reports.

Accounting

  • Review and process Expense Reports, Invoices and Advances to staff and ensure all documentation is according to the local laws.
  • Process payments and upload information to the bank.
  • Maintain the local accounting system and ensure the correct recording and coding of the information.
  • Keep accounting accounts conciliated and with the respective details.
  • Perform bookkeeping and preparation of monthly close with Regional Accounting Manager.
  • Ensure monthly closing.
  • Prepare and submit all local filings (tax and others).
  • Coordinate the annual country audit and support the global audit process and the local audits for projects.

WHAT YOU BRING:

  • Bachelor's or advanced degree in accounting.
  • 2+ years accounting, administration and/or human resources experience.
  • Accounting legal registration in Brazil.
  • Payroll preparation experience.
  • Knowledge and experience with softwares such as Netsuite , Salesforce, Sharepoint.

BENEFITS OF WORKING AT THE RAINFOREST ALLIANCE:

  • Benefit from remote working flexibility and flexible hybrid working environment.

  • Prioritize your wellbeing. We have numerous ways to promote work-life balance.

Apply now and let's grow together. We look forward to hearing from you and exploring how your skills can help us advance our mission.

title: Implementation Specialist
description:
Hospitality Implementation Coordinator – Sales & Catering Technology

Location: Brazil — Remote

Employment type: Full-time Contractor

English level: Advanced/Fluent

About the role

We are seeking Hospitality Implementation Coordinators to support the global rollout of a Sales & Catering platform across a large portfolio of hotel properties.

This is a hospitality implementation and project coordination role, not a technical support position. Each coordinator will manage a portfolio of hotels and serve as their primary point of contact throughout the implementation process.

The role is responsible for ensuring that hotel information is collected accurately, implementation activities remain on schedule, required training is completed, and issues are communicated to the appropriate teams. The successful candidate will coordinate closely with hotel properties, regional commercial stakeholders, corporate support teams, external vendors and technical resources.

Hospitality industry experience is the primary requirement. Technical experience is valuable but secondary.

Key responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary implementation contact for assigned hotel properties.
  • Coordinate hotel-level activities for the rollout of a Sales & Catering platform.
  • Guide properties through implementation milestones, readiness requirements and deployment gates.
  • Ensure required hotel data is accurately gathered, mapped, validated and entered into implementation workbooks and systems of record.
  • Follow up on missing information, corrections and data discrepancies.
  • Track implementation progress, critical deadlines and hotel activation status.
  • Identify delays and risks, take appropriate follow-up action and escalate issues when necessary.
  • Verify that required e-learning modules and training activities are completed before hotels advance to the next implementation phase.
  • Follow up with hotels that are behind schedule or have not completed required activities.
  • Coordinate between hotel properties, corporate support teams, regional commercial leads, external vendors and technical resources.
  • Facilitate consultation calls to ensure that platform configurations reflect each hotel’s operational and commercial needs.
  • Validate required participation agreements, billing arrangements and other property-level deployment requirements.
  • Maintain accurate implementation records, dashboards and status reports.
  • Provide regional stakeholders and program leadership with clear updates on implementation progress.
  • Support early-adopter initiatives and encourage hotels to begin implementation ahead of mandatory deadlines.
  • Help ensure consistent communication and execution across multiple implementation workstreams and hotel properties.

Required qualifications

  • At least three years of experience in the travel or hospitality industry.
  • Strong understanding of hotel operations and the impact that technology changes can have on property teams.
  • Experience working in or closely with hotel sales, catering, groups, events or commercial teams.
  • Advanced or fluent English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong project coordination, organization and timeline-management abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple hotel properties, priorities and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Strong relationship-building and influencing skills.
  • Ability to motivate stakeholders, reinforce deadlines and follow up consistently without direct authority.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving implementation risks.
  • Emotional intelligence, self-awareness and cultural sensitivity.
  • Confidence working with spreadsheets, implementation workbooks, dashboards, presentations and project-tracking tools.
  • Ability to work independently within a remote and internationally distributed team.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with Delphi, Delphi FDC, Amadeus Sales & Event Management or another hotel Sales & Catering platform.
  • Experience with Property Management Systems (PMS) or other hotel technology implementations.
  • Salesforce experience.
  • Previous involvement in hotel technology rollouts, system migrations, hotel openings or property conversions.
  • Experience supporting implementations across multiple hotel properties or regions.
  • Experience coordinating hotel teams, vendors and technical resources.
  • University degree in hospitality, business, project management or a related field. A degree is preferred but not required.

Ideal candidate

The ideal candidate understands hotel operations and has experience working with hotel sales, catering, groups or events teams. They recognize the operational disruption that a new system can create and can guide hotel teams through change with empathy, organization and accountability.

They are comfortable managing deadlines, following up persistently, maintaining accurate records and communicating with stakeholders at different levels of an organization. They do not need to be a technical specialist, but they should be confident working alongside technical teams and learning hotel technology platforms.

This role does not include

  • Technical product support or software troubleshooting.

title: Supervisor (a) de Alojamento
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

  • Controlar temas pertinentes a Alojamentos e Hospedagens apoiando em Alimentação e Transportes;

  • Supervisionar a Gestão de Infraestrutura e Facilities;

  • Supervisionar a Alimentação e Nutrição: monitorar a qualidade das refeições fornecidas, fiscalizar o cumprimento das normas sanitárias nas cozinhas e refeitórios.
  • Supervisionar os Suprimentos e Logística: controlar o estoque de materiais de limpeza, gerenciar a distribuição de enxoval de cama e banho.
  • Supervisionar a Segurança e Conformidade Legal: garantir o cumprimento integral das exigências legais para alojamentos rurais, fiscalizar o uso de equipamentos de proteção Coletiva (EPCs).
  • Supervisionar a Gestão de Pessoas e Convivência: aplicar as normas do regulamento interno da empresa.

title: Regional Finance Manager, Latin America
description:
Heidrick & Struggles is the world’s foremost advisor on executive leadership, driving superior client performance through premier human capital leadership advisory services. For more than 70 years, we’ve delivered value for our clients by leveraging unrivaled expertise to help organizations discover and enable outstanding leaders and teams. Learn more at

Job Description:

Who we Are

Heidrick & Struggles is a premier provider of global leadership advisory and on-demand talent solutions, serving the senior-level talent and consulting needs of the world's top organizations. In our role as trusted leadership advisors, we partner with our clients to develop future-ready leaders and organizations, bringing together our services and offerings in executive search, diversity and inclusion, leadership assessment and development, organization and team acceleration, culture shaping and on-demand, independent talent solutions. Heidrick & Struggles pioneered the profession of executive search more than 70 years ago. Today, the firm provides integrated talent and human capital solutions to help our clients change the world, one leadership team at a time.®

Additional information on the firm can be found at .

The Role

The Regional Finance Manager - Latin America (RFD) oversees the financial activities for the Latin America region, encompassing five offices across three countries which generate revenue more than USD 20M. The position reports directly to the Global Finance Director for Executive Search (GFD) and partners closely with the Latin America Regional Leader (RL) and the region’s operational management team. This role plays an integral part in the company’s strategic direction, development, and future growth in the region and serves as the primary finance liaison to field operational teams.

Responsibilities :

  • Lead and develop the Latin America Finance teams, ensuring high performance, engagement, and robust succession planning.
  • Oversee Latin America financial assurance, the control environment, operational analysis, and recurring financial and business processes with an investment and value-creation orientation.
  • Develop an intimate understanding of the regional business, its key drivers, and market dynamics, maintaining strong working relationships at all levels of operations.
  • Drive annual planning and forecasting processes to deliver office and practice budgets, as well as strategic plans that enhance regional success, growth, and profitability, in collaboration with corporate and operational teams.
  • Manage monthly and quarterly detailed financial reviews and management reporting packages to measure historical and current performance, providing clear insight and recommendations.
  • Generate and implement initiatives to improve operational efficiency and profitability across the region.
  • Create analyses and financial models to support regional growth initiatives, new investments, strategic and operational efforts, and to enable improved financial decision-making and sustainable performance improvement.
  • Use management information and KPIs to provide insight into trends that support the effective running of the region and drive continuous improvement.
  • Prepare presentations and supporting financial analysis and materials for leadership team meetings and regional reviews, as required.
  • Approve and manage regional expenditure budgets, ensuring disciplined cost management and alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Review and approve commercial Terms & Conditions for new business assignments, including margin expectations and risk considerations.
  • Own externally facing finance and operational components across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, including vendor relationships, leases, facilities obligations, landlord negotiations, benefits vendors, and other locally administered commercial matters, ensuring appropriate oversight, cost control, approval discipline, and escalation visibility.
  • Collaborate closely with regional finance leaders and accounting teams in other geographies to ensure alignment of financial strategies, policies, and operational goals.
  • Oversee locally administered payroll, consultant compensation, bonus accruals, statutory accounting, tax provisions, cash and intercompany activity, and related accounting entries, partnering with local tax, accounting, banking, legal, and labor compliance advisors to ensure alignment with US GAAP, statutory requirements, corporate policy, and local regulations.

Required Qualifications:

  • Undergraduate degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field, with a strong record of academic achievement.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of corporate finance experience, demonstrating increasing levels of responsibility and scope.
  • Proven track record operating as a trusted finance business partner to senior leadership.
  • Intelligent and highly creative individual, at ease interacting with executive decision makers and discussing the pros and cons of project alternatives as a respectful, equal participant.
  • Strong sense of how businesses operate in a global context and the ability to bring a macro perspective to business opportunities and regional decisions.
  • Demonstrated project management expertise, including leading complex, cross-functional initiatives to successful completion.
  • Fluency in English and at least one major Latin American language (Portuguese and/or Spanish).
  • Recognizes trends and events outside the organization and focuses the organization’s financial, operational and human capital on the issues that affect performance.
  • Superior analytical skills balanced by a keen ability to integrate the larger strategic picture, rapidly understand and explain complex issues in simple terms, and develop a range of potential solutions.
  • Develops and applies creative solutions to business problems, anticipates situations and needs, finds flexible answers to new situations, and champions innovation to improve business performance.
  • Forms networks of positive business relationships that enhance personal and business success.
  • Partners with colleagues across all departments, service lines, and other regions as one team to ensure a successful outcome for the firm.
  • A well-balanced individual defined not only as smart, but pragmatic.
  • An outstanding communicator with excellent negotiation skills who will be viewed as a team player, with the ability to build a network of support from people at both corporate and business unit levels.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex projects with an ability to drive successful outcomes with a shared commitment among a diverse team.
  • Ability to work with the senior leadership of the Company as a peer, and to be perceived as a valuable business partner.
  • A self-starter who is one step ahead while ensuring that others on the team are not left behind.
  • Able to position and coach others to achieve industry-leading standards.
  • Strong work ethic and unquestionable integrity.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Chartered Accountant qualification; part-qualified accountants will be considered.
  • Strong understanding of Latin America taxation and regulatory frameworks.
  • Professional services sector experience; direct industry experience in executive search is not required.
  • Additional language skills beyond English and Portuguese and/or Spanish.

All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, age, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, marital status, veteran or military status, or citizenship status.

title: Field Application Engineer
description:
Our client is a fast-growing pioneer in the agricultural robotics space, revolutionizing the farming industry by designing and building advanced, autonomous farm machines. By utilizing cutting-edge computer vision and machine learning, their technology enables farmers to understand and manage fields at a plant-by-plant level.

Backed as an independent subsidiary of one of the world's most respected global agricultural machinery giants, they combine the agile, fast-paced environment of a high-tech startup with the massive scaling power of an industry leader. Their mission is to improve global food production, increase farming profitability, and protect the environment by dramatically reducing pesticide use.

THE ROLE: FIELD APPLICATION ENGINEER (BRAZIL)

We are seeking a hands-on Field Application Engineer based in Brazil to help develop, support, and maintain next-generation "smart" farm machines. In this role, you will be the bridge between the field and the engineering team. You will carry out in-field product testing, troubleshoot complex electro-mechanical systems, and provide the crucial feedback needed to drive continuous product development.

This is an immediate-start opportunity with exciting potential to travel to the United States during the Brazilian off-season.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Field Application Engineer, your primary focus will be supporting smart machinery performance directly in the field:

  • In-Field Testing: Carry out hardware, software, and machine vision field tests on mechatronic agricultural machinery, providing detailed execution reports and documentation.
  • Technical Support: Collect field data, troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve technical issues on-site.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the vital link between customers, product management, agronomy, and engineering to communicate real-world user needs.
  • Documentation: Assist engineering teams in creating comprehensive product documentation, user guides, and instructional materials.
  • Systems Management: Track and manage recurring technical issues from initial identification to final resolution.
  • Logistics & Setup: Perform hands-on setup, maintenance, calibration, and transport of field-testing equipment as required.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Minimum Requirements:

  • Language Skills: Full professional fluency in both English and Portuguese (written and verbal).
  • Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Engineering, Computer Science, Agriculture, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience: Experience supporting, troubleshooting, or maintaining complex agricultural electro-mechanical systems (large machinery).
  • Technical Troubleshooting: Strong ability to diagnose complex systems spanning hardware, software, and mechanical components.
  • Communication & Mindset: Excellent customer-facing skills with a collaborative, team-oriented attitude.
  • Mobility: Valid driver's license with a safe driving record, and a strong willingness to travel frequently to agricultural fields.

Nice-to-Have Skills (Preferred but not required):

  • Familiarity with Linux environments and basic script programming.
  • Experience in designing and executing Design Verification Testing (DVT).
  • Basic programming/scripting skills in Python.
  • Familiarity with CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks).

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & WORKING CONDITIONS

  • This is an active, hands-on role in an outdoor environment. You should be comfortable standing, walking, bending, kneeling, and climbing in various weather conditions (hot and cold).
  • Ability to frequently lift/move items up to 25 pounds (and occasionally up to 50 pounds).
  • Strong visual acuity (including color vision and depth perception) to work with advanced camera and machine vision systems.

WHAT'S ON OFFER

  • Competitive Compensation Package with a highly collaborative, supportive, and forward-thinking work culture.
  • Fully Equipped: All tools, specialized equipment, and work vehicles are provided by the employer.
  • Travel Covered: 100% reimbursement for all work-related travel expenses.
  • Global Exposure: Unique opportunities for international collaboration and travel to US headquarters.
